name: Stickelberger.msa_eq_of_distrib
statement:
theorem msa_eq_of_distrib {M R : Type*} [Monoid M] [Semiring R] (a b : MulSemiringAction M R)
    (hd : a.toDistribMulAction = b.toDistribMulAction) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  cases a; cases b; congr 1

name: Stickelberger.galMul_eq_canonical
statement:
theorem galMul_eq_canonical :
    (IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction ℤ ℚ K (𝓞 K) : MulSemiringAction (K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) (𝓞 K))
      = (inferInstance : MulSemiringAction (K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) (𝓞 K))
proof:
:= by
  apply msa_eq_of_distrib
  ext g x
  rw [RingOfIntegers.coe_eq_algebraMap, RingOfIntegers.coe_eq_algebraMap]
  trans (g (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K x))
  · exact algebraMap_galRestrict_apply ℤ g x
  · exact ((by simpa using algebraMap.smul' g x K) :
      algebraMap (𝓞 K) K (g • x) = g (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K x)).symm

name: Stickelberger.twist_fixed
statement:
theorem twist_fixed {F L : Type*} [Field F] [Field L] [Algebra F L]
    {H : Subgroup (L ≃ₐ[F] L)} {g : L} {σc : L ≃ₐ[F] L} {m c : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (heig : ∀ τ ∈ H, ∃ u : L, u ^ m = 1 ∧ τ g = u * g)
    (hσc : ∀ u : L, u ^ m = 1 → σc u = u ^ c)
    (hcomm : ∀ τ ∈ H, ∀ x : L, τ (σc x) = σc (τ x)) :
    g ^ c * (σc g)⁻¹ ∈ IntermediateField.fixedField H
proof:
:= by
  rw [IntermediateField.mem_fixedField_iff]
  intro τ hτ
  obtain ⟨u, hum, hu⟩ := heig τ hτ
  have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := fun h => by rw [h, zero_pow hm.ne'] at hum; exact zero_ne_one hum
  have hucne : (u : L) ^ c ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero c hu0
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, hu, map_inv₀, hcomm τ hτ g, hu, map_mul, hσc u hum,
    mul_pow, mul_inv, mul_mul_mul_comm, mul_inv_cancel₀ hucne, one_mul]

name: Stickelberger.galEquiv_apply_comm
statement:
theorem galEquiv_apply_comm {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {L : Type*} [Field L] [NumberField L]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {n} ℚ L] (σ τ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (x : L) : τ (σ x) = σ (τ x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : σ * τ = τ * σ := by
    apply (IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.galEquivZMod n L).injective
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, mul_comm]
  have h2 := DFunLike.congr_fun h x
  simpa [AlgEquiv.mul_apply] using h2.symm

name: Stickelberger.sub_one_mul_geomSum_add_one
statement:
theorem sub_one_mul_geomSum_add_one {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (f : ℕ) :
    (p - 1) * (∑ i ∈ range f, p ^ i) + 1 = p ^ f
proof:
:= by
  induction f with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [sum_range_succ, Nat.mul_add, add_right_comm, ih, pow_succ]
    have hdist : p ^ n + (p - 1) * p ^ n = (1 + (p - 1)) * p ^ n := by ring
    rw [hdist, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hp, Nat.mul_comm]

name: Stickelberger.sub_one_mul_geomSum
statement:
theorem sub_one_mul_geomSum {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (f : ℕ) :
    (p - 1) * (∑ i ∈ range f, p ^ i) = p ^ f - 1
proof:
:= by
  have := sub_one_mul_geomSum_add_one hp f
  omega

name: Stickelberger.pow_self_modEq_one
statement:
theorem pow_self_modEq_one {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (f : ℕ) :
    p ^ f ≡ 1 [MOD p ^ f - 1]
proof:
:=
  ((Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' (Nat.one_le_pow _ _ hp)).mpr dvd_rfl).symm

name: Stickelberger.pow_modEq_pow_mod
statement:
theorem pow_modEq_pow_mod {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (f k : ℕ) :
    p ^ k ≡ p ^ (k % f) [MOD p ^ f - 1]
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.div_add_mod k f, pow_add, pow_mul]
  calc (p ^ f) ^ (k / f) * p ^ (k % f)
      ≡ 1 ^ (k / f) * p ^ (k % f) [MOD p ^ f - 1] :=
        Nat.ModEq.mul_right _ ((pow_self_modEq_one hp f).pow _)
    _ = p ^ (k % f) := by rw [one_pow, one_mul]

name: Stickelberger.mod_mul'
statement:
theorem mod_mul' (a : ℕ) {b c : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) :
    a % (b * c) = a % b + b * (a / b % c)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : a = (a % b + b * (a / b % c)) + b * c * (a / b / c) := by
    have e2 := Nat.div_add_mod (a / b) c
    calc a = b * (a / b) + a % b := (Nat.div_add_mod a b).symm
      _ = b * (c * (a / b / c) + a / b % c) + a % b := by rw [e2]
      _ = (a % b + b * (a / b % c)) + b * c * (a / b / c) := by ring
  have hr : a % b < b := Nat.mod_lt _ hb
  have hbc : b * (a / b % c + 1) ≤ b * c := by gcongr; exact Nat.mod_lt _ hc
  have hb2 : b * (a / b % c) + b ≤ b * c := by rw [← Nat.mul_succ]; exact hbc
  have h2 : a % b + b * (a / b % c) < b * c := by omega
  nth_rewrite 1 [h1]
  rw [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h2]

name: Stickelberger.sum_digit_mul_pow_eq_mod
statement:
theorem sum_digit_mul_pow_eq_mod {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (f h : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range f, (h / p ^ i % p) * p ^ i = h % p ^ f
proof:
:= by
  induction f generalizing h with
  | zero => simp [Nat.mod_one]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hsum : ∑ k ∈ range n, h / p ^ (k + 1) % p * p ^ (k + 1) = p * (h / p % p ^ n) := by
      rw [← ih (h / p), Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      rw [show p ^ (k + 1) = p * p ^ k from pow_succ' p k, Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul]
      ring
    rw [sum_range_succ', pow_succ', pow_zero, Nat.div_one, Nat.mul_one, hsum,
      mod_mul' h hp (pow_pos hp n)]
    omega

name: Stickelberger.sum_digit_mul_pow_eq
statement:
theorem sum_digit_mul_pow_eq {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) {f h : ℕ} (hf : h < p ^ f) :
    ∑ i ∈ range f, (h / p ^ i % p) * p ^ i = h
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_digit_mul_pow_eq_mod hp, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hf]

name: Stickelberger.exists_digit_lt
statement:
theorem exists_digit_lt {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) {f h : ℕ} (hf : h < p ^ f - 1) :
    ∃ k < f, h / p ^ k % p < p - 1
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  have hall : ∀ k ∈ range f, h / p ^ k % p = p - 1 := by
    intro k hk
    have h2 : h / p ^ k % p < p := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
    by_contra hne
    exact hcon ⟨k, Finset.mem_range.mp hk, by omega⟩
  have e1 : ∑ k ∈ range f, (h / p ^ k % p) * p ^ k = ∑ k ∈ range f, (p - 1) * p ^ k :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k hk => by rw [hall k hk])
  have hsum : h % p ^ f = p ^ f - 1 := by
    rw [← sum_digit_mul_pow_eq_mod hp f h, e1, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    exact sub_one_mul_geomSum hp f
  have hlt : h < p ^ f := by have := Nat.one_le_pow f p hp; omega
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt] at hsum
  omega

name: Stickelberger.sum_range_rotate
statement:
theorem sum_range_rotate {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (g : ℕ → M) (f k : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range f, g ((k + i) % f) = ∑ i ∈ range f, g i
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos f with hf | hf
  · simp [hf]
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, f = n + 1 := ⟨f - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => g i),
    ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => g ((k + i) % (n + 1)))]
  refine Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.addLeft (⟨k % (n + 1), Nat.mod_lt k n.succ_pos⟩ : Fin (n + 1)))
    (fun x : Fin (n + 1) => g ((k + x.val) % (n + 1)))
    (fun x : Fin (n + 1) => g x.val) (fun x => ?_)
  simp only [Equiv.coe_addLeft, Fin.val_add]
  congr 1
  exact ((Nat.mod_modEq k (n + 1)).add_right x.val).symm

name: Stickelberger.rotatedSum_lt
statement:
theorem rotatedSum_lt {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) {f h : ℕ} (hf : h < p ^ f - 1) (i : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range f, (h / p ^ k % p) * p ^ ((i + k) % f) < p ^ f - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hrot : ∑ k ∈ range f, p ^ ((i + k) % f) = ∑ k ∈ range f, p ^ k :=
    sum_range_rotate (fun j => p ^ j) f i
  have hub : ∑ k ∈ range f, (p - 1) * p ^ ((i + k) % f) = p ^ f - 1 := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hrot, sub_one_mul_geomSum (by omega) f]
  rw [← hub]
  apply Finset.sum_lt_sum
  · intro k _
    have hd : h / p ^ k % p < p := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
    gcongr
    omega
  · obtain ⟨k, hkf, hkd⟩ := exists_digit_lt (by omega : 1 ≤ p) hf
    exact ⟨k, Finset.mem_range.mpr hkf, mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hkd (by positivity)⟩

name: Stickelberger.modEq_sum
statement:
theorem modEq_sum {α : Type*} {n : ℕ} {F G : α → ℕ} {s : Finset α}
    (h : ∀ a ∈ s, F a ≡ G a [MOD n]) : ∑ a ∈ s, F a ≡ ∑ a ∈ s, G a [MOD n]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => rfl
  | insert a t ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha]
    exact (h a (Finset.mem_insert_self a t)).add
      (ih fun b hb => h b (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hb))

name: Stickelberger.perTerm_value
statement:
theorem perTerm_value {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) {f h : ℕ} (hf : h < p ^ f - 1) (i : ℕ) :
    (p ^ i * h) % (p ^ f - 1) = ∑ k ∈ range f, (h / p ^ k % p) * p ^ ((i + k) % f)
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : h < p ^ f := by have := Nat.one_le_pow f p (by omega); omega
  have e1 : p ^ i * h = ∑ k ∈ range f, (h / p ^ k % p) * p ^ (i + k) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← sum_digit_mul_pow_eq (by omega) hlt]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    rw [pow_add]; ring
  have hmod : p ^ i * h ≡ ∑ k ∈ range f, (h / p ^ k % p) * p ^ ((i + k) % f) [MOD p ^ f - 1] := by
    rw [e1]
    exact modEq_sum (fun k _ => Nat.ModEq.mul_left _ (pow_modEq_pow_mod (by omega) f (i + k)))
  have key : (p ^ i * h) % (p ^ f - 1) =
      (∑ k ∈ range f, (h / p ^ k % p) * p ^ ((i + k) % f)) % (p ^ f - 1) := hmod
  rw [key, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (rotatedSum_lt hp hf i)]

name: Stickelberger.sub_one_mul_sum_perTerm
statement:
theorem sub_one_mul_sum_perTerm {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) {f h : ℕ} (hf : h < p ^ f - 1) :
    (p - 1) * ∑ i ∈ range f, ((p ^ i * h) % (p ^ f - 1)) = digitSumF p f h * (p ^ f - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hrot : ∀ k, ∑ i ∈ range f, p ^ ((i + k) % f) = ∑ j ∈ range f, p ^ j := by
    intro k
    rw [show (fun i => p ^ ((i + k) % f)) = (fun i => p ^ ((k + i) % f)) from by
      funext i; rw [Nat.add_comm]]
    exact sum_range_rotate (fun j => p ^ j) f k
  have step : ∑ i ∈ range f, ((p ^ i * h) % (p ^ f - 1)) =
      digitSumF p f h * ∑ j ∈ range f, p ^ j := by
    calc ∑ i ∈ range f, ((p ^ i * h) % (p ^ f - 1))
        = ∑ i ∈ range f, ∑ k ∈ range f, (h / p ^ k % p) * p ^ ((i + k) % f) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => perTerm_value hp hf i)
      _ = ∑ k ∈ range f, ∑ i ∈ range f, (h / p ^ k % p) * p ^ ((i + k) % f) := Finset.sum_comm
      _ = ∑ k ∈ range f, (h / p ^ k % p) * ∑ i ∈ range f, p ^ ((i + k) % f) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => by rw [Finset.mul_sum])
      _ = ∑ k ∈ range f, (h / p ^ k % p) * ∑ j ∈ range f, p ^ j :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => by rw [hrot])
      _ = digitSumF p f h * ∑ j ∈ range f, p ^ j := by rw [digitSumF, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [step, mul_left_comm, sub_one_mul_geomSum (by omega) f]

name: Stickelberger.digitSumF_one
statement: theorem digitSumF_one (p h : ℕ) : digitSumF p 1 h = h % p
proof:
:= by
  rw [digitSumF, Finset.sum_range_one, pow_zero, Nat.div_one]

name: Stickelberger.mul_units_val_eq_floor
statement:
theorem mul_units_val_eq_floor {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (a : (ZMod m)ˣ) (c : ℕ) :
    c * (a : ZMod m).val = ((a : ZMod m) * (c : ZMod m)).val + m * (c * (a : ZMod m).val / m)
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv := (Nat.div_add_mod (c * (a : ZMod m).val) m).symm
  have hmod : c * (a : ZMod m).val % m = ((a : ZMod m) * (c : ZMod m)).val := by
    rw [ZMod.val_mul, ZMod.val_natCast, ← Nat.mod_mul_mod, mul_comm (c % m),
      mul_comm (a : ZMod m).val]
  rw [hmod, add_comm] at hdiv
  exact hdiv

name: Stickelberger.div_mul_one_add_mul_mod
statement:
theorem div_mul_one_add_mul_mod {r ℓ a j : ℕ} (hr0 : 0 < r) (hrdvd : r ∣ ℓ - 1)
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ - 1) (ha : a < r) :
    ((ℓ - 1) / r * a * (1 + r * j)) % (ℓ - 1) = (ℓ - 1) / r * a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hrdvd
  have hd : (ℓ - 1) / r = k := by rw [hk, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hr0]
  have hk0 : 0 < k := by
    rw [hk] at hℓ
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | h
    · simp at hℓ
    · exact h
  rw [hd]
  have hrw : k * a * (1 + r * j) = k * a + (ℓ - 1) * (a * j) := by rw [hk]; ring
  rw [hrw, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  rw [hk]
  calc k * a < k * r := (Nat.mul_lt_mul_left hk0).mpr ha
    _ = r * k := Nat.mul_comm k r

name: Stickelberger.div_mul_mod_of_mod_eq_one
statement:
theorem div_mul_mod_of_mod_eq_one {r ℓ a k : ℕ} (hr0 : 0 < r) (hrdvd : r ∣ ℓ - 1) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ - 1)
    (ha : a < r) (hk : k % r = 1) :
    ((ℓ - 1) / r * a * k) % (ℓ - 1) = (ℓ - 1) / r * a
proof:
:= by
  have hdm := Nat.div_add_mod k r
  rw [hk] at hdm
  have hke : k = 1 + r * (k / r) := by omega
  rw [hke]
  exact div_mul_one_add_mul_mod hr0 hrdvd hℓ ha

name: Stickelberger.div_mul_mod_eq
statement:
theorem div_mul_mod_eq {ℓ m k : ℕ} (hm0 : 0 < m) (hmdvd : m ∣ ℓ - 1) :
    (ℓ - 1) / m * k % (ℓ - 1) = (ℓ - 1) / m * (k % m)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (ℓ - 1) with hℓ0 | hℓpos
  · simp [hℓ0]
  have hcancel : (ℓ - 1) / m * m = ℓ - 1 := Nat.div_mul_cancel hmdvd
  have hmod : (ℓ - 1) / m * k % (ℓ - 1) = (ℓ - 1) / m * (k % m) % (ℓ - 1) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.div_add_mod k m, Nat.mul_add]
    conv_lhs => lhs; lhs; rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, hcancel]
    rw [Nat.mul_add_mod_self_left]
  rw [hmod]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos ((ℓ - 1) / m) with hq0 | hqpos
  · simp [hq0]
  have hkmod : k % m < m := Nat.mod_lt k hm0
  have hlt : (ℓ - 1) / m * (k % m) < ℓ - 1 :=
    calc (ℓ - 1) / m * (k % m) < (ℓ - 1) / m * m := (Nat.mul_lt_mul_left hqpos).mpr hkmod
      _ = ℓ - 1 := hcancel
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt

name: Stickelberger.m_mul_digitSumF_div_mul
statement:
theorem m_mul_digitSumF_div_mul {p m : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) {f t : ℕ} (hf : 1 ≤ f)
    (hmdvd : m ∣ p ^ f - 1) (hm : 0 < m) (ht : t < m) :
    m * digitSumF p f ((p ^ f - 1) / m * t) = (p - 1) * ∑ i ∈ range f, (p ^ i * t) % m
proof:
:= by
  have hpf : 2 ≤ p ^ f := by
    calc 2 ≤ p := hp
      _ = p ^ 1 := (pow_one p).symm
      _ ≤ p ^ f := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hf
  have hq1 : 0 < p ^ f - 1 := by omega
  have hdpos : 0 < (p ^ f - 1) / m := Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hq1 hmdvd) (by omega)
  have hlt : (p ^ f - 1) / m * t < p ^ f - 1 := by
    calc (p ^ f - 1) / m * t < (p ^ f - 1) / m * m := (Nat.mul_lt_mul_left hdpos).mpr ht
      _ = p ^ f - 1 := Nat.div_mul_cancel hmdvd
  have hterm : ∀ i, (p ^ i * ((p ^ f - 1) / m * t)) % (p ^ f - 1)
      = (p ^ f - 1) / m * ((p ^ i * t) % m) := by
    intro i
    rw [show p ^ i * ((p ^ f - 1) / m * t) = (p ^ f - 1) / m * (p ^ i * t) by ring,
      div_mul_mod_eq hm hmdvd]
  have e := sub_one_mul_sum_perTerm hp hlt
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hterm i), ← Finset.mul_sum] at e
  
  have hmul : m * ((p - 1) * ((p ^ f - 1) / m * ∑ i ∈ range f, (p ^ i * t) % m))
      = m * (digitSumF p f ((p ^ f - 1) / m * t) * (p ^ f - 1)) := by rw [e]
  have hLHS : m * ((p - 1) * ((p ^ f - 1) / m * ∑ i ∈ range f, (p ^ i * t) % m))
      = (p - 1) * (∑ i ∈ range f, (p ^ i * t) % m) * (p ^ f - 1) := by
    rw [show m * ((p - 1) * ((p ^ f - 1) / m * ∑ i ∈ range f, (p ^ i * t) % m))
          = (p - 1) * (∑ i ∈ range f, (p ^ i * t) % m) * (m * ((p ^ f - 1) / m)) by ring,
      Nat.mul_div_cancel' hmdvd]
  rw [hLHS] at hmul
  
  refine (Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hq1 ?_).symm
  rw [hmul]; ring

name: Stickelberger.stickelberger_congruence
statement:
theorem stickelberger_congruence (p c m : ℕ) (_hm : 0 < m) (t f : ℕ) :
    c * ∑ i ∈ range f, (p ^ i * t) % m
      = (∑ i ∈ range f, (p ^ i * ((c * t) % m)) % m)
        + m * ∑ i ∈ range f, c * ((p ^ i * t) % m) / m
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  have h1 : (p ^ i * ((c * t) % m)) % m = (c * ((p ^ i * t) % m)) % m := by
    calc (p ^ i * ((c * t) % m)) % m
        = (p ^ i * (c * t)) % m := Nat.ModEq.mul_left _ (Nat.mod_modEq _ _)
      _ = (c * (p ^ i * t)) % m := by rw [show p ^ i * (c * t) = c * (p ^ i * t) by ring]
      _ = (c * ((p ^ i * t) % m)) % m := (Nat.ModEq.mul_left _ (Nat.mod_modEq _ _)).symm
  rw [h1]
  exact (Nat.mod_add_div _ _).symm

name: Stickelberger.sum_range_div_mod
statement:
theorem sum_range_div_mod (p a m : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∑ h ∈ range (a * m), (h / a % p) = a * ∑ k ∈ range m, (k % p)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Nat.mul_succ, Finset.sum_range_add, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ, mul_add]
    congr 1
    have hconst : ∀ x ∈ range a, (a * n + x) / a % p = n % p := fun x hx => by
      rw [Nat.mul_add_div ha, Nat.div_eq_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp hx), add_zero]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hconst, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, smul_eq_mul]

name: Stickelberger.sum_range_mod
statement:
theorem sum_range_mod (p c : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range (p * c), (k % p) = c * ∑ d ∈ range p, d
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Nat.mul_succ, Finset.sum_range_add, ih]
    have hblk : ∑ x ∈ range p, ((p * n + x) % p) = ∑ d ∈ range p, d :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x hx => by
        rw [Nat.mul_add_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp hx)])
    rw [hblk, add_one_mul]

name: Stickelberger.two_mul_sum_digit
statement:
theorem two_mul_sum_digit {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) {f i : ℕ} (hi : i < f) :
    2 * ∑ h ∈ range (p ^ f), (h / p ^ i % p) = p ^ f * (p - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : p ^ f = p ^ i * (p * p ^ (f - i - 1)) := by
    rw [← pow_succ', ← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
  rw [hsplit, sum_range_div_mod p (p ^ i) (p * p ^ (f - i - 1)) (pow_pos (by omega) i),
    sum_range_mod p (p ^ (f - i - 1))]
  have h2 : 2 * ∑ d ∈ range p, d = p * (p - 1) := by
    rw [mul_comm]; exact Finset.sum_range_id_mul_two p
  rw [show 2 * (p ^ i * (p ^ (f - i - 1) * ∑ d ∈ range p, d))
      = p ^ i * p ^ (f - i - 1) * (2 * ∑ d ∈ range p, d) by ring, h2]
  ring

name: Stickelberger.two_mul_sum_digitSumF
statement:
theorem two_mul_sum_digitSumF {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (f : ℕ) :
    2 * ∑ h ∈ range (p ^ f), digitSumF p f h = f * p ^ f * (p - 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold digitSumF
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.mul_sum,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => two_mul_sum_digit hp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)),
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: Stickelberger.digitSumF_pow_sub_one
statement:
theorem digitSumF_pow_sub_one {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (f : ℕ) :
    digitSumF p f (p ^ f - 1) = f * (p - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hdig : ∀ i ∈ range f, (p ^ f - 1) / p ^ i % p = p - 1 := by
    intro i hi
    have hif : i < f := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    have hpi : 1 ≤ p ^ i := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
    have hfact : p ^ f = p ^ i * p ^ (f - i) := by rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
    have hdiv : (p ^ f - 1) / p ^ i = p ^ (f - i) - 1 := by
      have hdec : p ^ i * p ^ (f - i) - 1 = p ^ i * (p ^ (f - i) - 1) + (p ^ i - 1) := by
        rw [Nat.mul_sub_one]
        have : p ^ i ≤ p ^ i * p ^ (f - i) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by positivity)
        omega
      rw [hfact, hdec, Nat.mul_add_div (by omega), Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega), add_zero]
    rw [hdiv]
    have hc : p ^ (f - i) = p * p ^ (f - i - 1) := by rw [← pow_succ']; congr 1; omega
    rw [hc]
    have hd : p * p ^ (f - i - 1) - 1 = p * (p ^ (f - i - 1) - 1) + (p - 1) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_sub_one]
      have : p ≤ p * p ^ (f - i - 1) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by positivity)
      omega
    rw [hd, Nat.mul_add_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  rw [digitSumF, Finset.sum_congr rfl hdig, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, smul_eq_mul]

name: Stickelberger.two_mul_sum_digitSumF_lt
statement:
theorem two_mul_sum_digitSumF_lt {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (f : ℕ) :
    2 * ∑ α ∈ range (p ^ f - 1), digitSumF p f α = f * (p - 1) * (p ^ f - 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hfp : 1 ≤ p ^ f := Nat.one_le_pow f p (by omega)
  have hsucc : p ^ f = (p ^ f - 1) + 1 := by omega
  have hsplit : ∑ α ∈ range (p ^ f), digitSumF p f α
      = ∑ α ∈ range (p ^ f - 1), digitSumF p f α + digitSumF p f (p ^ f - 1) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hsucc]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
  have htot := two_mul_sum_digitSumF (show 1 ≤ p by omega) f
  rw [hsplit, digitSumF_pow_sub_one hp f, Nat.mul_add,
    show f * p ^ f * (p - 1) = f * (p - 1) * p ^ f from by ring] at htot
  rw [Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib, show f * (p - 1) * 2 = 2 * (f * (p - 1)) from by ring]
  omega

name: Stickelberger.sum_mod_p_pow_shift
statement:
theorem sum_mod_p_pow_shift {p m f : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hmdvd : m ∣ p ^ f - 1) (j t : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range f, p ^ i * (p ^ j * t % m) % m = ∑ i ∈ range f, p ^ i * t % m
proof:
:= by
  have hpf1 : p ^ f ≡ 1 [MOD m] :=
    ((Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' (Nat.one_le_pow f p hp)).mpr hmdvd).symm
  have hpk : ∀ k, p ^ k ≡ p ^ (k % f) [MOD m] := fun k => by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.div_add_mod k f, pow_add, pow_mul]
    calc (p ^ f) ^ (k / f) * p ^ (k % f)
        ≡ 1 ^ (k / f) * p ^ (k % f) [MOD m] := Nat.ModEq.mul_right _ (hpf1.pow _)
      _ = p ^ (k % f) := by rw [one_pow, one_mul]
  have step1 : ∀ i, p ^ i * (p ^ j * t % m) % m = p ^ ((i + j) % f) * t % m := fun i => by
    calc p ^ i * (p ^ j * t % m) % m
        = p ^ i * (p ^ j * t) % m := Nat.ModEq.mul_left (p ^ i) (Nat.mod_modEq _ m)
      _ = p ^ (i + j) * t % m := by rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_add]
      _ = p ^ ((i + j) % f) * t % m := Nat.ModEq.mul_right t (hpk (i + j))
  calc ∑ i ∈ range f, p ^ i * (p ^ j * t % m) % m
      = ∑ i ∈ range f, p ^ ((i + j) % f) * t % m := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => step1 i)
    _ = ∑ i ∈ range f, (fun k => p ^ k * t % m) ((j + i) % f) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; rw [Nat.add_comm i j]
    _ = ∑ i ∈ range f, p ^ i * t % m := sum_range_rotate (fun k => p ^ k * t % m) f j

name: Stickelberger.orderOf_natCast_pow_sub_one
statement:
theorem orderOf_natCast_pow_sub_one {p f : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 1 ≤ f) :
    orderOf (p : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) = f
proof:
:= by
  have hple : p ≤ p ^ f := by
    calc p = p ^ 1 := (pow_one p).symm
      _ ≤ p ^ f := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hf
  have key : ((p ^ f : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) = 1 := by
    rw [(ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff (p ^ f) 1 (p ^ f - 1)).mpr (pow_self_modEq_one (by omega) f)]
    exact Nat.cast_one
  have hpf : (p : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) ^ f = 1 := by rw [← key]; push_cast; ring
  have hdvd : orderOf (p : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) ∣ f := orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one hpf
  refine Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd) ?_
  by_contra hlt
  set d := orderOf (p : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) with hd
  have hlt2 : d < f := Nat.not_le.mp hlt
  have hpos : 0 < d := by
    rw [hd]; exact (isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.mpr ⟨f, by omega, hpf⟩).orderOf_pos
  have hpd2 : 2 ≤ p ^ d := by
    calc 2 ≤ p := hp
      _ = p ^ 1 := (pow_one p).symm
      _ ≤ p ^ d := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hpos
  have hd1 : ((p ^ d : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) = ((1 : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_one, hd]; exact pow_orderOf_eq_one _
  have hmod : (p ^ d : ℕ) ≡ 1 [MOD p ^ f - 1] := (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ _).mp hd1
  have hNdvd : (p ^ f - 1) ∣ p ^ d - 1 :=
    (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' (by omega)).mp hmod.symm
  have hpd : p ^ d < p ^ f := Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by omega) hlt2
  have hle := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hNdvd
  omega

name: Stickelberger.not_dvd_pow_sub_one
statement: theorem not_dvd_pow_sub_one {p f : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hf : 1 ≤ f) : ¬ p ∣ (p ^ f - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hp2 : 2 ≤ p := hp.out.two_le
  have hple : p ≤ p ^ f := by
    calc p = p ^ 1 := (pow_one p).symm
      _ ≤ p ^ f := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hf
  intro hdvd
  have h0 : p ∣ p ^ f := dvd_pow_self p (by omega)
  rw [show p ^ f = (p ^ f - 1) + 1 by omega] at h0
  have hd1 : p ∣ 1 := (Nat.dvd_add_right hdvd).mp h0
  have := Nat.dvd_one.mp hd1
  omega

name: Stickelberger.ramificationIdx_eq_sub_one
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_eq_sub_one {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] {m p : ℕ}
    [hp : Fact p.Prime] [NeZero (p * m)] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p * m} ℚ K]
    (hpm : ¬ p ∣ m) (P : Ideal (𝓞 K)) [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})] :
    Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) P = p - 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.ramificationIdx_eq (n := p * m) (m := m) (p := p) (k := 0)
    (K := K) (P := P) (show p * m = p ^ (0 + 1) * m by simp) hpm
  simpa using h

name: Stickelberger.absNorm_eq_pow_of_ramified
statement:
theorem absNorm_eq_pow_of_ramified {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] {p f : ℕ}
    [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hf : 1 ≤ f) [NeZero (p * (p ^ f - 1))]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {p * (p ^ f - 1)} ℚ K] (P : Ideal (𝓞 K)) [P.IsPrime]
    [P.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})] :
    Ideal.absNorm P = p ^ f
proof:
:= by
  have hp2 : 2 ≤ p := hp.out.two_le
  rw [Ideal.absNorm_eq_pow_inertiaDeg' P hp.out,
    IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.inertiaDeg_eq (n := p * (p ^ f - 1)) (m := p ^ f - 1) (p := p)
      (k := 0) (K := K) (P := P) (by simp) (not_dvd_pow_sub_one (p := p) hf),
    orderOf_natCast_pow_sub_one hp2 hf]

name: Stickelberger.sq_dvd_one_add_pow_sub
statement:
theorem sq_dvd_one_add_pow_sub {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (x : R) (k : ℕ) :
    x ^ 2 ∣ (1 + x) ^ k - (1 + k • x)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨c + (n : R) + x * c, ?_⟩
    have hexp : (1 + x) ^ n = x ^ 2 * c + (1 + n • x) := sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hc
    rw [pow_succ', hexp]
    push_cast [nsmul_eq_mul]
    ring

name: Stickelberger.associated_sub_one_pow
statement:
theorem associated_sub_one_pow {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    {ζ : R} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ p) : Associated ((ζ - 1) ^ (p - 1)) (p : R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, p = n + 1 := ⟨p - 1, by have := hp.out.pos; omega⟩
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  have hord := hζ.prod_pow_sub_one_eq_order
  have hcop : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range n, (k + 1).Coprime (n + 1) := by
    intro k hk
    have hk' : k < n := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
    refine (hp.out.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr (fun hdvd => ?_)).symm
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd
    omega
  have hfac : Associated (∏ k ∈ Finset.range n, (ζ ^ (k + 1) - 1)) ((ζ - 1) ^ n) := by
    have := Associated.prod (Finset.range n) (fun k => ζ ^ (k + 1) - 1) (fun _ => ζ - 1)
      (fun k hk => (hζ.associated_sub_one_pow_sub_one_of_coprime (hcop k hk)).symm)
    rwa [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_range] at this
  have hu : IsUnit ((-1 : R) ^ n) := isUnit_one.neg.pow n
  have hassoc2 : Associated (∏ k ∈ Finset.range n, (ζ ^ (k + 1) - 1)) ((n : R) + 1) :=
    ⟨hu.unit, by rw [IsUnit.unit_spec, mul_comm]; exact hord⟩
  rw [show ((n + 1 : ℕ) : R) = (n : R) + 1 by push_cast; ring]
  exact hfac.symm.trans hassoc2

name: Stickelberger.emultiplicity_span_p_eq_ramificationIdx
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_span_p_eq_ramificationIdx {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (P : Ideal (𝓞 K)) [P.IsPrime] (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥)
    [P.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})] :
    emultiplicity P (Ideal.span {(p : 𝓞 K)}) = Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) P
proof:
:= by
  have hpℤ : Prime ((p : ℤ)) := Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.mp hp.out
  have hv : Prime (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) := Ideal.prime_span_singleton_iff.mpr hpℤ
  have hvbot : Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)} ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]; exact_mod_cast hp.out.ne_zero
  have hPp : Prime P := Ideal.prime_of_isPrime hP0 ‹P.IsPrime›
  have hmap : Ideal.span {(p : 𝓞 K)} = (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}).map (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 K)) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, map_natCast]
  rw [hmap, IsDedekindDomain.emultiplicity_map_eq_ramificationIdx_mul hvbot hv.irreducible
      hPp.irreducible hP0,
    (FiniteMultiplicity.of_prime_left hv hvbot).emultiplicity_self, mul_one]

name: Stickelberger.emultiplicity_map_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_map_ringEquiv {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (τ : R ≃+* R) (P I : Ideal R) :
    emultiplicity (P.map (τ : R →+* R)) (I.map (τ : R →+* R)) = emultiplicity P I
proof:
:=
  emultiplicity_map_eq
    ({ toFun := Ideal.map (τ : R →+* R)
       invFun := Ideal.map (τ.symm : R →+* R)
       left_inv := fun J => by rw [Ideal.map_map]; simp
       right_inv := fun J => by rw [Ideal.map_map]; simp
       map_mul' := Ideal.map_mul τ } : Ideal R ≃* Ideal R)

name: Stickelberger.liesOver_of_natCast_mem
statement:
theorem liesOver_of_natCast_mem {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    {Q : Ideal (𝓞 K)} [Q.IsPrime] (hp_mem : (p : 𝓞 K) ∈ Q) :
    Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : (p : ℤ) ∈ Q.under ℤ := by
    rw [Ideal.mem_under]; simpa using hp_mem
  have hle : Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)} ≤ Q.under ℤ := by
    rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]; exact hmem
  exact ⟨(Int.ideal_span_isMaximal_of_prime p).eq_of_le (Ideal.IsPrime.under ℤ Q).ne_top hle⟩

name: Stickelberger.emultiplicity_span_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_span_pow_eq_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R]
    {Q : Ideal R} (hQ : Prime Q) {x : R} (hx : x ∉ Q) (n : ℕ) :
    emultiplicity Q (Ideal.span {x ^ n}) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [emultiplicity_eq_zero, Ideal.dvd_span_singleton]
  exact fun hmem => hx ((Ideal.isPrime_of_prime hQ).mem_of_pow_mem n hmem)

name: Stickelberger.emultiplicity_smul
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_smul {M R : Type*} [Group M] [CommRing R] [MulSemiringAction M R]
    (σ : M) (P : Ideal R) (x : R) :
    emultiplicity (σ • P) (Ideal.span {σ • x}) = emultiplicity P (Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:= by
  have hτ : (MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv M R σ : R →+* R) = MulSemiringAction.toRingHom M R σ :=
    RingHom.ext (congrFun rfl)
  rw [Ideal.pointwise_smul_def, show σ • x = MulSemiringAction.toRingHom M R σ x from rfl,
    show (Ideal.span {MulSemiringAction.toRingHom M R σ x} : Ideal R)
      = (Ideal.span {x}).map (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom M R σ) from by
        rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton], ← hτ]
  exact emultiplicity_map_ringEquiv (MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv M R σ) P (Ideal.span {x})

name: Stickelberger.emultiplicity_zeta_sub_one
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_zeta_sub_one {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] {m p : ℕ}
    [hp : Fact p.Prime] [NeZero (p * m)] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p * m} ℚ K] (hpm : ¬ p ∣ m)
    {P : Ideal (𝓞 K)} [P.IsPrime] (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥) [P.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})]
    {ζ : 𝓞 K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ p) :
    emultiplicity P (Ideal.span {ζ - 1}) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hPp : Prime P := Ideal.prime_of_isPrime hP0 ‹P.IsPrime›
  have hvp : emultiplicity P (Ideal.span {(p : 𝓞 K)}) = ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [emultiplicity_span_p_eq_ramificationIdx P hP0, ramificationIdx_eq_sub_one hpm P]
  have hspan : Ideal.span {(p : 𝓞 K)} = (Ideal.span {ζ - 1}) ^ (p - 1) := by
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
    exact Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton.mpr (associated_sub_one_pow hζ).symm
  rw [hspan, emultiplicity_pow hPp] at hvp
  have hp1 : (p - 1 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by have := hp.out.two_le; omega
  
  have h2 := congrArg ENat.toNat hvp
  rw [ENat.toNat_mul, ENat.toNat_coe] at h2
  have hv1 : (emultiplicity P (Ideal.span {ζ - 1})).toNat = 1 :=
    Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hp1) (by rw [mul_one]; exact h2)
  simpa using (ENat.toNat_eq_iff one_ne_zero).mp hv1

name: Stickelberger.emultiplicity_eq_one_of_sub_mem
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_eq_one_of_sub_mem {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    {P : Ideal (𝓞 K)} {a b : 𝓞 K}
    (hb : emultiplicity P (Ideal.span {b}) = 1) (hab : a - b ∈ P ^ 2) :
    emultiplicity P (Ideal.span {a}) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hbP : b ∈ P := by
    have h1 : P ^ 1 ∣ Ideal.span {b} := pow_dvd_iff_le_emultiplicity.mpr (by simp [hb])
    rwa [pow_one, Ideal.dvd_span_singleton] at h1
  have hbP2 : b ∉ P ^ 2 := by
    intro h
    have h2 := le_emultiplicity_of_pow_dvd (Ideal.dvd_span_singleton.mpr h)
    rw [hb] at h2
    simp at h2
  have hP2P : P ^ 2 ≤ P := Ideal.pow_le_self (by norm_num)
  have haP : a ∈ P := by
    have hsum : a = b + (a - b) := by ring
    rw [hsum]; exact P.add_mem hbP (hP2P hab)
  have haP2 : a ∉ P ^ 2 := by
    intro h
    refine hbP2 ?_
    have hsum : b = a - (a - b) := by ring
    rw [hsum]; exact (P ^ 2).sub_mem h hab
  refine emultiplicity_eq_of_dvd_of_not_dvd (k := 1) ?_ ?_
  · rw [pow_one, Ideal.dvd_span_singleton]; exact haP
  · rw [Ideal.dvd_span_singleton]; exact haP2

name: Stickelberger.isPrimitiveRoot_zetaRL
statement:
theorem isPrimitiveRoot_zetaRL {r : ℕ} (hrdvd : r ∣ p ^ f - 1) :
    IsPrimitiveRoot (zetaRL (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) r
proof:
:= by
  have hO : IsPrimitiveRoot
      (zetaInteger (K := L) (p * (p ^ f - 1)) ^ (p * ((p ^ f - 1) / r))) r := by
    refine (zetaInteger_isPrimitiveRoot (p * (p ^ f - 1))).pow
      (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne _)) ?_
    rw [mul_assoc, Nat.div_mul_cancel hrdvd]
  exact hO.map_of_injective (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (𝓞 L) L)

name: Stickelberger.isCyclotomic_kSubR
statement:
theorem isCyclotomic_kSubR {r : ℕ} (hr0 : 0 < r) (hrdvd : r ∣ p ^ f - 1) :
    IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : NeZero r := ⟨by omega⟩
  unfold kSubR
  exact (isPrimitiveRoot_zetaRL (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) hrdvd)
    |>.intermediateField_adjoin_isCyclotomicExtension (K := ℚ)

name: Stickelberger.not_dvd_r
statement: theorem not_dvd_r {r : ℕ} (hrdvd : r ∣ p ^ f - 1) : ¬ p ∣ r
proof:
:= by
  have hf1 : 1 ≤ f := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos f with h | h
    · subst h; exact absurd (by simp : p * (p ^ 0 - 1) = 0) (NeZero.ne _)
    · exact h
  intro hpr
  have h1 : p ∣ p ^ f - 1 := hpr.trans hrdvd
  have h2 : p ∣ p ^ f := dvd_pow_self p (by omega)
  have hpf : 1 ≤ p ^ f := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ hp.out.pos
  have h3 : p ∣ 1 := by
    have hd := Nat.dvd_sub h2 h1
    rwa [Nat.sub_sub_self hpf] at hd
  exact Nat.Prime.one_lt hp.out |>.ne' (Nat.dvd_one.mp h3)

name: Stickelberger.algebraMap_gal_smul
statement:
theorem algebraMap_gal_smul {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (τ : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) (y : 𝓞 K) :
    algebraMap (𝓞 K) K (τ • y) = τ (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [algebraMap.smul']
  rfl

name: Stickelberger.algebraMap_gal_smul_galMul
statement:
theorem algebraMap_gal_smul_galMul {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (τ : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) (y : 𝓞 K) :
    algebraMap (𝓞 K) K (τ • y) = τ (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K y)
proof:
:= by
  letI : MulSemiringAction (K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) (𝓞 K) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction ℤ ℚ K (𝓞 K)
  rw [← algebraMap_galRestrict_apply ℤ τ y, galRestrict_apply]
  rfl

name: Stickelberger.algebraMap_smul_restrictNormal_smul
statement:
theorem algebraMap_smul_restrictNormal_smul {r : ℕ} [NeZero r]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (y : 𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) :
    algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) L
        ((σ.restrictNormal (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) • y)
      = σ (algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) L y)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Normal ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) :=
    IsGalois.to_normal (F := ℚ) (E := kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)
  set τ := σ.restrictNormal (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)
  letI : MulSemiringAction ((kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) ≃ₐ[ℚ]
      (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction ℤ ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)
      (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))
  have hτ := algebraMap_gal_smul_galMul (K := kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) τ y
  calc algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) L (τ • y)
      _ = algebraMap (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) L
            (algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))
              (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) (τ • y)) := by
          simp only [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))
            (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) L]
      _ = algebraMap (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) L
            (τ (algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))
              (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) y)) := congrArg
                (algebraMap (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) L) hτ
      _ = σ (algebraMap (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) L
            (y : kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) :=
          AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes σ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)
            (y : kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)
      _ = σ (algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) L y) := by
          simp only [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))
            (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) L]

name: Stickelberger.algebraMap_inv_smul_restrictNormal_inv_smul
statement:
theorem algebraMap_inv_smul_restrictNormal_inv_smul {r : ℕ} [NeZero r]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (y : 𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) :
    σ⁻¹ (algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) L y)
      = algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) L
          ((σ.restrictNormal (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))⁻¹ • y)
proof:
:= by
  letI : MulSemiringAction ((kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) ≃ₐ[ℚ]
      (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction ℤ ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)
      (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))
  set ρ := σ.restrictNormal (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)
  have h := algebraMap_smul_restrictNormal_smul (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) σ (ρ⁻¹ • y)
  have hy : y = ρ • ρ⁻¹ • y := (smul_inv_smul ρ y).symm
  calc σ⁻¹ (algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) L y)
      _ = σ⁻¹ (algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) L (ρ • ρ⁻¹ • y)) := by
          congr 1; exact congrArg _ hy
      _ = σ.symm (algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) L (ρ • ρ⁻¹ • y)) := rfl
      _ = algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) L (ρ⁻¹ • y) :=
          (congr_arg σ.symm h).trans
            (AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply σ (algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) L
              (ρ⁻¹ • y)))

name: Stickelberger.under_smul_eq_restrictNormal_smul_under
statement:
theorem under_smul_eq_restrictNormal_smul_under {r : ℕ} [NeZero r]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (Q : Ideal (𝓞 L)) :
    (σ • Q).under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))
      = (σ.restrictNormal (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))
          • (Q.under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)))
proof:
:= by
  set τ := σ.restrictNormal (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)
  letI : MulSemiringAction ((kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) ≃ₐ[ℚ]
      (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction ℤ ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)
      (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))
  ext x
  simp only [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem]
  have heq : σ⁻¹ • (algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) (𝓞 L) x) =
      algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) (𝓞 L) (τ⁻¹ • x) := by
    apply FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (𝓞 L) L
    calc algebraMap (𝓞 L) L (σ⁻¹ • (algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) (𝓞 L) x))
        _ = σ⁻¹ (algebraMap (𝓞 L) L
            (algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) (𝓞 L) x)) :=
            algebraMap_gal_smul (K := L) σ⁻¹
              (algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) (𝓞 L) x)
        _ = algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) L (τ⁻¹ • x) := by
            rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) (𝓞 L) L]
            exact algebraMap_inv_smul_restrictNormal_inv_smul σ x
        _ = algebraMap (𝓞 L) L
            ((algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) (𝓞 L) (τ⁻¹ • x))) := by
            rw [← RingOfIntegers.coe_eq_algebraMap,
              IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) (𝓞 L) L]
  rw [heq]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: Stickelberger.conjugatePrime_kSubR_surjective
statement:
theorem conjugatePrime_kSubR_surjective {r : ℕ} [NeZero r]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    (𝔭₀ 𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))) [𝔭₀.IsPrime]
    [𝔭₀.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})] [𝔭.IsPrime] [𝔭.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})] :
    ∃ a : (ZMod r)ˣ, conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a = 𝔭
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_galEquiv_smul_eq (p := p) (m := r) 𝔭₀ 𝔭
  refine ⟨(galZMod r (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) σ)⁻¹, ?_⟩
  simp only [conjugatePrime, inv_inv, MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  exact hσ

name: Stickelberger.stabilizer_kSubR_eq_bot
statement:
theorem stabilizer_kSubR_eq_bot {r : ℕ} [NeZero r]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    (_hr0 : 0 < r) (hrdvd : r ∣ p ^ f - 1)
    (hp1 : (p : ZMod r) = 1)
    (𝔭₀ : Ideal (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))) [𝔭₀.IsMaximal]
    [𝔭₀.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})] :
    stabilizer ((kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) ≃ₐ[ℚ] (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) 𝔭₀
      = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hn : p.Coprime r := (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hp.out).mpr (not_dvd_r hrdvd)
  let K' := kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r
  let G := K' ≃ₐ[ℚ] K'
  let e : G ≃* (ZMod r)ˣ := galZMod r K'
  
  
  
  
  have hmap : e.mapSubgroup (stabilizer Gal(K'/ℚ) 𝔭₀) =
      Subgroup.zpowers (ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn) := by
    rw [show (galMulSemiringAction : MulSemiringAction (K' ≃ₐ[ℚ] K') (𝓞 K'))
        = _ from galMul_eq_canonical]
    exact IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.galEquivZMod_stabilizer r K' p 𝔭₀ hn
  have huc : ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn = 1 := by
    apply Units.ext
    rw [ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime p hn, hp1]
    rfl
  rw [huc, Subgroup.zpowers_one_eq_bot] at hmap
  rw [Subgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall]
  intro g hg
  have hin : e g ∈ e.mapSubgroup (stabilizer Gal(K'/ℚ) 𝔭₀) := ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
  rw [hmap, Subgroup.mem_bot] at hin
  exact e.injective (hin.trans (map_one e).symm)

name: Stickelberger.stabilizer_kSubR_image
statement:
theorem stabilizer_kSubR_image {r : ℕ} [NeZero r]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    (hn : p.Coprime r)
    (𝔭₀ : Ideal (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))) [𝔭₀.IsMaximal]
    [𝔭₀.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})] :
    (galZMod r (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)).mapSubgroup
        (stabilizer ((kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) ≃ₐ[ℚ]
          (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) 𝔭₀)
      = Subgroup.zpowers (ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (galMulSemiringAction : MulSemiringAction
        ((kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) ≃ₐ[ℚ] (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))
        (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))) = _ from galMul_eq_canonical]
  exact IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.galEquivZMod_stabilizer r
    (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) p 𝔭₀ hn

name: Stickelberger.conjugatePrime_eq_iff
statement:
theorem conjugatePrime_eq_iff {r : ℕ} [NeZero r]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    (hn : p.Coprime r)
    (𝔭₀ : Ideal (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))) [𝔭₀.IsMaximal]
    [𝔭₀.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})] (a b : (ZMod r)ˣ) :
    conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a = conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ b
      ↔ b * a⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn)
proof:
:= by
  have hstab : (galZMod r (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)).symm a⁻¹ • 𝔭₀
        = (galZMod r (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)).symm b⁻¹ • 𝔭₀
      ↔ ((galZMod r (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)).symm b⁻¹)⁻¹
          * (galZMod r (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)).symm a⁻¹
        ∈ stabilizer ((kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) ≃ₐ[ℚ]
            (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) 𝔭₀ := by
    rw [mem_stabilizer_iff, mul_smul, inv_smul_eq_iff]
  rw [conjugatePrime, conjugatePrime, hstab, ← map_inv, inv_inv, ← map_mul,
    ← stabilizer_kSubR_image hn 𝔭₀, MulEquiv.coe_mapSubgroup, Subgroup.mem_map_equiv]

name: Stickelberger.MulAction.smul_injective_of_stabilizer_eq_bot
statement:
theorem MulAction.smul_injective_of_stabilizer_eq_bot {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G X]
    (x : X) (h : stabilizer G x = ⊥) : Function.Injective (fun g : G => g • x)
proof:
:= by
  intro g₁ g₂ hg
  simp only at hg
  have hmem : g₂⁻¹ * g₁ ∈ stabilizer G x := by
    rw [mem_stabilizer_iff, mul_smul, hg, inv_smul_smul]
  rw [h, Subgroup.mem_bot, inv_mul_eq_one] at hmem
  exact hmem.symm

name: Stickelberger.conjugatePrime_kSubR_injective_of_eq_one
statement:
theorem conjugatePrime_kSubR_injective_of_eq_one {r : ℕ} [NeZero r]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    (hr0 : 0 < r) (hrdvd : r ∣ p ^ f - 1)
    (hp1 : (p : ZMod r) = 1)
    (𝔭₀ : Ideal (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))) [𝔭₀.IsMaximal]
    [𝔭₀.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})] :
    Function.Injective (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ : (ZMod r)ˣ →
      Ideal (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)))
proof:
:= by
  let K' := kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r
  let G := K' ≃ₐ[ℚ] K'
  let e : G ≃* (ZMod r)ˣ := galZMod r K'
  have hstab : stabilizer G 𝔭₀ = ⊥ :=
    stabilizer_kSubR_eq_bot (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) hr0 hrdvd hp1 𝔭₀
  have hsmul : Function.Injective (fun σ : G => σ • 𝔭₀) :=
    MulAction.smul_injective_of_stabilizer_eq_bot 𝔭₀ hstab
  intro a b hab
  
  have : (e.symm a⁻¹) • 𝔭₀ = (e.symm b⁻¹) • 𝔭₀ := hab
  have hσeq : e.symm a⁻¹ = e.symm b⁻¹ := hsmul this
  have haib : a⁻¹ = b⁻¹ := e.symm.injective hσeq
  exact inv_inj.mp haib

name: Stickelberger.orderOf_unitOfCoprime_eq
statement:
theorem orderOf_unitOfCoprime_eq {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hn : p.Coprime m)
    (hmf : orderOf (p : ZMod m) = f) :
    orderOf (ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn) = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hmf, ← orderOf_units, ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime]

name: Stickelberger.sum_fiber_val_eq_sum_range
statement:
theorem sum_fiber_val_eq_sum_range {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hn : p.Coprime m)
    (hmf : orderOf (p : ZMod m) = f) (a₀ : (ZMod m)ˣ) :
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter
        (fun a : (ZMod m)ˣ => a * a₀⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn)),
      (a : ZMod m).val
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range f, ((a₀ * ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn ^ i : (ZMod m)ˣ) : ZMod m).val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hord : orderOf (ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn) = f := orderOf_unitOfCoprime_eq hn hmf
  have hinj : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range f, ∀ j ∈ Finset.range f,
      a₀ * ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn ^ i = a₀ * ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn ^ j → i = j := by
    intro i hi j hj hij
    have h2 : ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn ^ i = ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn ^ j := mul_left_cancel hij
    exact pow_injOn_Iio_orderOf (by rw [hord]; exact Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
      (by rw [hord]; exact Finset.mem_range.mp hj) h2
  have hset : Finset.univ.filter
      (fun a : (ZMod m)ˣ => a * a₀⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn))
      = (Finset.range f).image (fun i => a₀ * ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn ^ i) := by
    ext a
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range]
    rw [mem_zpowers_iff_mem_range_orderOf, hord]
    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, hpow⟩
      exact ⟨i, hi, by rw [hpow, mul_comm a a₀⁻¹, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul]⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨i, hi, by rw [mul_comm a₀ (ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn ^ i), mul_assoc,
        mul_inv_cancel, mul_one]⟩
  rw [hset, Finset.sum_image hinj]

name: Stickelberger.coe_mul_pow_val
statement:
theorem coe_mul_pow_val {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hn : p.Coprime m) (a₀ : (ZMod m)ˣ) (i : ℕ) :
    ((a₀ * ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn ^ i : (ZMod m)ˣ) : ZMod m).val
      = (a₀ : ZMod m).val * p ^ i % m
proof:
:= by
  have hcoe : ((a₀ * ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn ^ i : (ZMod m)ˣ) : ZMod m)
      = (a₀ : ZMod m) * (p : ZMod m) ^ i := by
    rw [Units.val_mul, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime]
  rw [hcoe, ZMod.val_mul, ← Nat.cast_pow, ZMod.val_natCast]
  exact Nat.ModEq.mul_left _ (Nat.mod_modEq _ _)

name: Stickelberger.sum_fiber_val_eq_s
statement:
theorem sum_fiber_val_eq_s {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hn : p.Coprime m)
    (hmf : orderOf (p : ZMod m) = f) (a₀ : (ZMod m)ˣ) :
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter
        (fun a : (ZMod m)ˣ => a * a₀⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn)),
      (a : ZMod m).val
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range f, (a₀ : ZMod m).val * p ^ i % m
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_fiber_val_eq_sum_range hn hmf a₀]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => coe_mul_pow_val hn a₀ i)

name: Stickelberger.sum_fiber_eq_sum_range
statement:
theorem sum_fiber_eq_sum_range {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hn : p.Coprime m)
    (hmf : orderOf (p : ZMod m) = f) (a₀ : (ZMod m)ˣ) {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (g : (ZMod m)ˣ → M) :
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter
        (fun a : (ZMod m)ˣ => a * a₀⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn)), g a
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range f, g (a₀ * ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn ^ i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hord : orderOf (ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn) = f := orderOf_unitOfCoprime_eq hn hmf
  have hinj : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range f, ∀ j ∈ Finset.range f,
      a₀ * ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn ^ i = a₀ * ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn ^ j → i = j := by
    intro i hi j hj hij
    have h2 : ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn ^ i = ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn ^ j := mul_left_cancel hij
    exact pow_injOn_Iio_orderOf (by rw [hord]; exact Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
      (by rw [hord]; exact Finset.mem_range.mp hj) h2
  have hset : Finset.univ.filter
      (fun a : (ZMod m)ˣ => a * a₀⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn))
      = (Finset.range f).image (fun i => a₀ * ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn ^ i) := by
    ext a
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range]
    rw [mem_zpowers_iff_mem_range_orderOf, hord]
    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, hpow⟩
      exact ⟨i, hi, by rw [hpow, mul_comm a a₀⁻¹, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul]⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨i, hi, by rw [mul_comm a₀ (ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn ^ i), mul_assoc,
        mul_inv_cancel, mul_one]⟩
  rw [hset, Finset.sum_image hinj]

name: Stickelberger.sum_fiber_floor_eq
statement:
theorem sum_fiber_floor_eq {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hn : p.Coprime m)
    (hmf : orderOf (p : ZMod m) = f) (a₀ : (ZMod m)ˣ) (c : ℕ) :
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter
        (fun a : (ZMod m)ˣ => a * a₀⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn)),
      c * (a : ZMod m).val / m
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range f, c * ((a₀ : ZMod m).val * p ^ i % m) / m
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_fiber_eq_sum_range hn hmf a₀ (fun a => c * (a : ZMod m).val / m)]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [coe_mul_pow_val hn a₀ i])

name: Stickelberger.galEquivZMod_restrictNormal_kSubR
statement:
theorem galEquivZMod_restrictNormal_kSubR {r : ℕ} [NeZero r] (hrdvd : r ∣ p ^ f - 1)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]

        (σ.restrictNormal (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))

name: Stickelberger.under_smul_P_eq_conjugatePrime_iff
statement:
theorem under_smul_P_eq_conjugatePrime_iff {r : ℕ} [NeZero r]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    (hr0 : 0 < r) (hrdvd : r ∣ p ^ f - 1) (hp1 : (p : ZMod r) = 1)
    {𝔭₀ : Ideal (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))} [𝔭₀.IsMaximal]
    [𝔭₀.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})]
    (hP0 : P.under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) = 𝔭₀)
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (a : (ZMod r)ˣ) :
    (σ • P).under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) = conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a
      ↔ ZMod.unitsMap (hrdvd.trans (dvd_mul_left _ _))
            (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ) = a⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  set τ := σ.restrictNormal (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)
  set e := galZMod r (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)
  have hunder : (σ • P).under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) = τ • 𝔭₀ := by
    rw [under_smul_eq_restrictNormal_smul_under, hP0]
  have hstab : stabilizer ((kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) ≃ₐ[ℚ]
      (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) 𝔭₀ = ⊥ :=
    stabilizer_kSubR_eq_bot (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) hr0 hrdvd hp1 𝔭₀
  have hsmul : Function.Injective
      (fun g : (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) ≃ₐ[ℚ] (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) =>
        g • 𝔭₀) :=
    MulAction.smul_injective_of_stabilizer_eq_bot 𝔭₀ hstab
  rw [hunder, conjugatePrime, hsmul.eq_iff, eq_comm, MulEquiv.symm_apply_eq e,
    ← galEquivZMod_restrictNormal_kSubR hrdvd σ, eq_comm]
  simp only [e, galZMod, τ]

name: Stickelberger.under_smul_P_eq_conjugatePrime_coset
statement:
theorem under_smul_P_eq_conjugatePrime_coset {r : ℕ} [NeZero r]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    (hrdvd : r ∣ p ^ f - 1) (hn : p.Coprime r)
    {𝔭₀ : Ideal (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))} [𝔭₀.IsMaximal]
    [𝔭₀.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})]
    (hP0 : P.under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) = 𝔭₀)
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (a : (ZMod r)ˣ) :
    (σ • P).under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) = conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a
      ↔ a * ZMod.unitsMap (hrdvd.trans (dvd_mul_left _ _)) (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ)
          ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn)
proof:
:= by
  have hunder : (σ • P).under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r))
      = σ.restrictNormal (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) • 𝔭₀ := by
    rw [under_smul_eq_restrictNormal_smul_under, hP0]
  have hτ : σ.restrictNormal (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) • 𝔭₀
      = conjugatePrime 𝔭₀
          ((galZMod r (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)
            (σ.restrictNormal (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)))⁻¹) := by
    rw [conjugatePrime, inv_inv, MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [hunder, hτ, conjugatePrime_eq_iff hn, inv_inv]
  simp only [galZMod]
  rw [galEquivZMod_restrictNormal_kSubR hrdvd σ]

name: Stickelberger.unitsMap_eq_imp_val_mod
statement:
theorem unitsMap_eq_imp_val_mod {n r : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hr : 2 ≤ r) (h : r ∣ n)
    (v : (ZMod n)ˣ) (a : (ZMod r)ˣ) (hv : ZMod.unitsMap h v = a) :
    (v : ZMod n).val % r = (a : ZMod r).val
proof:
:= by
  haveI : NeZero r := ⟨by omega⟩
  have h0 : ((v : ZMod n).val : ZMod r) = (((a : ZMod r).val : ℕ) : ZMod r) := by
    have h1 := congrArg Units.val hv
    rw [ZMod.unitsMap_def, Units.coe_map, MonoidHom.coe_coe, ZMod.castHom_apply,
      ← ZMod.natCast_val] at h1
    rw [h1, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.cast_id]
  have hmod : (v : ZMod n).val ≡ (a : ZMod r).val [MOD r] :=
    (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ _).mp h0
  rw [Nat.ModEq] at hmod
  rw [hmod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (ZMod.val_lt _)]

name: Stickelberger.galExp_inv_mod_eq_index
statement:
theorem galExp_inv_mod_eq_index {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hr : 2 ≤ m) (hrdvd : m ∣ p ^ f - 1)
    (hp1 : (p : ZMod m) = 1)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {m} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    {𝔭₀ : Ideal (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))} [𝔭₀.IsMaximal]
    [𝔭₀.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})]
    (hP0 : P.under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) = 𝔭₀)
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (a : (ZMod m)ˣ)
    (hfib : (σ • P).under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) = conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) :
    (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val % m = (a : ZMod m).val
proof:
:= by
  have hua := (under_smul_P_eq_conjugatePrime_iff (by omega) hrdvd hp1 hP0 σ a).mp hfib
  have hinv : ZMod.unitsMap (hrdvd.trans (dvd_mul_left _ _))
      (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹) = a := by
    rw [map_inv, map_inv, hua, inv_inv]
  exact unitsMap_eq_imp_val_mod hr _ _ a hinv

name: Stickelberger.unitsMap_galEquivZMod_eq_one_of_restrictNormal_eq_one
statement:
theorem unitsMap_galEquivZMod_eq_one_of_restrictNormal_eq_one {r : ℕ} [NeZero r]
    (hrdvd : r ∣ p ^ f - 1)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L)
    (hσ : σ.restrictNormal (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) = 1) :
    ZMod.unitsMap (hrdvd.trans (dvd_mul_left _ _)) (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ) = 1

name: Stickelberger.unitsMap_eq_one_imp_val_mod_eq_one
statement:
theorem unitsMap_eq_one_imp_val_mod_eq_one {n r : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hr : 2 ≤ r) (h : r ∣ n)
    (v : (ZMod n)ˣ) (hv : ZMod.unitsMap h v = 1) : (v : ZMod n).val % r = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : NeZero r := ⟨by omega⟩
  have h0 : ((v : ZMod n).val : ZMod r) = 1 := by
    have h1 := congrArg Units.val hv
    rw [ZMod.unitsMap_def, Units.coe_map, MonoidHom.coe_coe, ZMod.castHom_apply, ← ZMod.natCast_val,
      Units.val_one] at h1
    exact h1
  have hmod : (v : ZMod n).val ≡ 1 [MOD r] :=
    (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ _).mp (by rw [Nat.cast_one]; exact h0)
