name: Stickelberger.galExp_inv_val_mod_eq_one_of_restrictNormal_eq_one
statement:
theorem galExp_inv_val_mod_eq_one_of_restrictNormal_eq_one {r : ℕ} [NeZero r] (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (hrdvd : r ∣ p ^ f - 1)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (hσ : σ.restrictNormal (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) = 1) :
    (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val % r = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hum := unitsMap_galEquivZMod_eq_one_of_restrictNormal_eq_one (L := L) (p := p) (f := f)
    hrdvd σ hσ
  have hinv : ZMod.unitsMap (hrdvd.trans (dvd_mul_left _ _))
      (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹) = 1 := by
    rw [map_inv, map_inv, hum, inv_one]
  exact unitsMap_eq_one_imp_val_mod_eq_one hr _ _ hinv

name: Stickelberger.inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul_self_of_restrictNormal
statement:
theorem inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul_self_of_restrictNormal {r β : ℕ} [NeZero r] (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (hrdvd : r ∣ p ^ f - 1) (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hβ : β < r)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (hσ : σ.restrictNormal (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r) = 1) :
    ∃ u : (𝓞 L)ˣ,
      σ⁻¹ • gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / r * β))
          (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) =
        ↑u * gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / r * β))
          (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)
proof:
:= by
  have hk := galExp_inv_val_mod_eq_one_of_restrictNormal_eq_one (L := L) (p := p) (f := f)
    hr hrdvd σ hσ
  have hℓ : 0 < p ^ f - 1 := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (p ^ f - 1) with h0 | h0
    · exact absurd (by rw [h0, Nat.mul_zero] : p * (p ^ f - 1) = 0) (NeZero.ne _)
    · exact h0
  have hdpos : 0 < (p ^ f - 1) / r :=
    Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hℓ hrdvd) (by omega)
  have hα : (p ^ f - 1) / r * β < p ^ f - 1 := by
    calc (p ^ f - 1) / r * β < (p ^ f - 1) / r * r := by
            exact (Nat.mul_lt_mul_left hdpos).mpr hβ
      _ = p ^ f - 1 := Nat.div_mul_cancel hrdvd
  have hαk : (p ^ f - 1) / r * β * (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val
      ≡ (p ^ f - 1) / r * β [MOD p ^ f - 1] := by
    rw [Nat.ModEq, div_mul_mod_of_mod_eq_one (by omega) hrdvd hℓ hβ hk, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hα]
  exact inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul_self (P := P) hf σ ((p ^ f - 1) / r * β) hαk

name: Stickelberger.gaussSum_pow_mem_ringOfIntegers_kSubR
statement:
theorem gaussSum_pow_mem_ringOfIntegers_kSubR {r β : ℕ} [NeZero r] (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (hrdvd : r ∣ p ^ f - 1) (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hβ : β < r)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)] :
    ∃ y : 𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r),
      (algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r)) (𝓞 L)) y =
        gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / r * β))
          (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) ^ r
proof:
:= by
  set K' := kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) r
  set ω := (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ with hω
  set ψ := psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf with hψ
  set α := (p ^ f - 1) / r * β with hα
  set g := gaussSum (ω ^ α) ψ with hg
  set gr := g ^ r with hgr
  haveI : IsGalois ℚ L := IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois {p * (p ^ f - 1)} ℚ L
  haveI : Normal ℚ L := IsGalois.to_normal (F := ℚ) (E := L)
  haveI : Normal ℚ ↥K' := IsGalois.to_normal (F := ℚ) (E := ↥K')
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℚ L := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {p * (p ^ f - 1)} ℚ L
  have hαk (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (hσ : σ.restrictNormal K' = 1) :
      α * (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val ≡ α [MOD p ^ f - 1] := by
    have hk := galExp_inv_val_mod_eq_one_of_restrictNormal_eq_one (L := L) (p := p) (f := f)
      hr hrdvd σ hσ
    have hℓ : 0 < p ^ f - 1 := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (p ^ f - 1) with h0 | h0
      · exact absurd (by rw [h0, Nat.mul_zero] : p * (p ^ f - 1) = 0) (NeZero.ne _)
      · exact h0
    have hdpos : 0 < (p ^ f - 1) / r :=
      Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hℓ hrdvd) (by omega)
    have hαlt : α < p ^ f - 1 := by
      dsimp [α]
      calc (p ^ f - 1) / r * β < (p ^ f - 1) / r * r := (Nat.mul_lt_mul_left hdpos).mpr hβ
        _ = p ^ f - 1 := Nat.div_mul_cancel hrdvd
    rw [Nat.ModEq, div_mul_mod_of_mod_eq_one (by omega) hrdvd hℓ hβ hk, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hαlt]
  have hpow_smul_inv (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (hσ : σ.restrictNormal K' = 1) : σ⁻¹ • gr = gr := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul_self_of_restrictNormal (L := L) (p := p)
      (f := f) (P := P) hr hrdvd hf hβ σ hσ
    have huk := inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul_self_unit_pow_eq_one (P := P) (p := p) hf hrdvd σ
      (hαk σ hσ) u hu
    calc σ⁻¹ • gr = σ⁻¹ • g ^ r := rfl
      _ = (σ⁻¹ • g) ^ r := smul_pow σ⁻¹ g r
      _ = (↑u * g) ^ r := by rw [hu]
      _ = (↑u) ^ r * g ^ r := mul_pow (↑u : 𝓞 L) g r
      _ = ↑(u ^ r) * g ^ r := by rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val]
      _ = g ^ r := by rw [huk, Units.val_one, one_mul]
  have hpow_smul (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (hσ : σ.restrictNormal K' = 1) : σ • gr = gr := by
    calc σ • gr = σ • (σ⁻¹ • gr) := by rw [hpow_smul_inv σ hσ]
      _ = gr := smul_inv_smul σ gr
  have hfixField : (gr : L) ∈ IntermediateField.fixedField (K'.fixingSubgroup) := by
    rw [IntermediateField.mem_fixedField_iff]
    intro τ hτ
    have hτfix := (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff (K := K') τ).mp hτ
    have hτ' : τ.restrictNormal ↥K' = 1 := by
      rw [AlgEquiv.ext_iff]
      intro x
      have hval : (τ.restrictNormal ↥K') x = x :=
        (algebraMap ↥K' L).injective (by
          rw [AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes (E := ↥K')]
          exact hτfix (x : L) x.property)
      simpa [AlgEquiv.one_apply] using congrArg Subtype.val hval
    rw [RingOfIntegers.coe_eq_algebraMap]
    exact (algebraMap.smul' τ gr L).symm.trans (congrArg (algebraMap (𝓞 L) L) (hpow_smul τ hτ'))
  have hfield : (gr : L) ∈ K' := by
    rwa [← IsGalois.fixedField_fixingSubgroup (F := ℚ) (E := L) (K := K')]
  set y : K' := ⟨gr, hfield⟩
  have hy : (algebraMap K' L) y = (gr : L) := rfl
  have hint : IsIntegral ℤ (gr : L) :=
    (mem_integralClosure_iff (R := ℤ) (A := L)).1 (SetLike.coe_mem gr)
  have hyint : IsIntegral ℤ y := by
    rw [← isIntegral_algebraMap_iff (R := ℤ) (algebraMap (↥K') L).injective, hy]
    exact hint
  refine ⟨⟨y, (mem_integralClosure_iff (R := ℤ) (A := ↥K')).2 hyint⟩, ?_⟩
  apply RingOfIntegers.ext
  exact hy

name: Stickelberger.gaussSum_eigenvector_field
statement:
theorem gaussSum_eigenvector_field {m β : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hr : 2 ≤ m) (hrdvd : m ∣ p ^ f - 1)
    (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hβ : β < m)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {m} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    (τ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (hτ : τ ∈ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m).fixingSubgroup) :
    ∃ u : L, u ^ m = 1 ∧
      τ (algebraMap (𝓞 L) L (gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * β))
          (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)))
        = u * algebraMap (𝓞 L) L
          (gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * β))
          (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf))
proof:
:= by
  set K' := kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m
  set gs := gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * β))
      (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) with hgs
  have hτfix := (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff (K := K') τ).mp hτ
  have hτ' : τ⁻¹.restrictNormal K' = 1 := by
    rw [AlgEquiv.ext_iff]; intro x
    have hval : (τ⁻¹.restrictNormal K') x = x :=
      (algebraMap K' L).injective (by
        rw [AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes (E := K')]
        exact (AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq τ).mpr (hτfix (x : L) x.property).symm)
    simpa [AlgEquiv.one_apply] using congrArg Subtype.val hval
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul_self_of_restrictNormal (L := L) (p := p) (f := f)
    (P := P) hr hrdvd hf hβ τ⁻¹ hτ'
  rw [inv_inv] at hu
  have hℓ : 0 < p ^ f - 1 := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (p ^ f - 1) with h0 | h0
    · exact absurd (by rw [h0, Nat.mul_zero] : p * (p ^ f - 1) = 0) (NeZero.ne _)
    · exact h0
  have hαk : (p ^ f - 1) / m * β * (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L (τ⁻¹)⁻¹).val.val
      ≡ (p ^ f - 1) / m * β [MOD p ^ f - 1] := by
    have hk := galExp_inv_val_mod_eq_one_of_restrictNormal_eq_one (L := L) (p := p) (f := f)
      hr hrdvd τ⁻¹ hτ'
    have hαlt : (p ^ f - 1) / m * β < p ^ f - 1 := by
      have hdpos : 0 < (p ^ f - 1) / m := Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hℓ hrdvd) (by omega)
      calc (p ^ f - 1) / m * β < (p ^ f - 1) / m * m := (Nat.mul_lt_mul_left hdpos).mpr hβ
        _ = p ^ f - 1 := Nat.div_mul_cancel hrdvd
    rw [Nat.ModEq, div_mul_mod_of_mod_eq_one (by omega) hrdvd hℓ hβ hk, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hαlt]
  have hum : u ^ m = 1 := inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul_self_unit_pow_eq_one (P := P) (p := p) hf
    hrdvd τ⁻¹ hαk u (by rw [inv_inv]; exact hu)
  refine ⟨algebraMap (𝓞 L) L (u : 𝓞 L), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← map_pow, ← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, hum, Units.val_one, map_one]
  · have hbridge : algebraMap (𝓞 L) L (τ • gs) = τ (algebraMap (𝓞 L) L gs) :=
      algebraMap_galRestrict_apply ℤ τ gs
    rw [← hbridge, hu, map_mul]

name: Stickelberger.gaussSum_twist_mem_kSubR
statement:
theorem gaussSum_twist_mem_kSubR {m β c : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hr : 2 ≤ m) (hrdvd : m ∣ p ^ f - 1)
    (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hβ : β < m)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {m} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    (σc : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (hc : (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σc).val.val ≡ c [MOD m]) :
    (algebraMap (𝓞 L) L (gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * β))
        (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf))) ^ c *
      (σc (algebraMap (𝓞 L) L
          (gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * β))
        (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf))))⁻¹
      ∈ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m : IntermediateField ℚ L)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsGalois ℚ L := IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois {p * (p ^ f - 1)} ℚ L
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℚ L := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {p * (p ^ f - 1)} ℚ L
  have hmem := twist_fixed (F := ℚ) (L := L)
    (H := (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m).fixingSubgroup) (σc := σc) (m := m) (c := c)
    (by omega)
    (fun τ hτ => gaussSum_eigenvector_field (P := P) hr hrdvd hf hβ τ hτ)
    (fun u hu => smul_eq_pow_c_field σc (by omega) hrdvd hu hc)
    (fun τ _ x => galEquiv_apply_comm (n := p * (p ^ f - 1)) σc τ x)
  rwa [IsGalois.fixedField_fixingSubgroup] at hmem

name: Stickelberger.gaussSumIdeal_pow_eq_map
statement:
theorem gaussSumIdeal_pow_eq_map {m β : ℕ} (hf : 1 ≤ f)
    {y : 𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)}
    (hy : algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (𝓞 L) y =
      gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * β))
        (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) ^ m) :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (𝓞 L)) (Ideal.span {y})
      = (gaussSumIdeal (P := P) (p := p) hf ((p ^ f - 1) / m * β)) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, hy, gaussSumIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]

name: Stickelberger.ramificationIdx_L_prime_eq
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_L_prime_eq (hf : 1 ≤ f) (v : Ideal (𝓞 L)) [v.IsPrime]
    [v.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})] :
    Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) v = p - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpm : ¬ p ∣ (p ^ f - 1) := by
    intro h
    have h2 : p ∣ p ^ f := dvd_pow_self p (by omega)
    have hpf : 1 ≤ p ^ f := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ hp.out.pos
    have h3 : p ∣ 1 := by
      have hd := Nat.dvd_sub h2 h
      rwa [Nat.sub_sub_self hpf] at hd
    exact hp.out.one_lt.ne' (Nat.dvd_one.mp h3)
  exact ramificationIdx_eq_sub_one (K := L) (m := p ^ f - 1) (p := p) hpm v

name: Stickelberger.ramificationIdx_under_v_eq
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_under_v_eq {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hmdvd : m ∣ p ^ f - 1)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {m} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    (v : Ideal (𝓞 L)) [v.IsPrime] [v.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})] :
    (v.under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))).ramificationIdx v = p - 1
proof:
:= by
  set cp := v.under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))
  haveI : cp.IsPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.under _ v
  haveI : cp.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) :=
    Ideal.under_liesOver_of_liesOver (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))
      (𝔓 := v) (p := Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})
  have hm : ¬ p ∣ m := not_dvd_r hmdvd
  haveI : IsScalarTower ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m) L := inferInstance
  haveI : IsScalarTower (𝓞 ℚ) (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (𝓞 L) := inferInstance
  haveI : IsScalarTower ℤ (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (𝓞 L) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => rfl
  have h := Ideal.ramificationIdx_algebra_tower' (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) cp v
  rw [ramificationIdx_L_prime_eq hf v,
    IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.ramificationIdx_eq_of_not_dvd p
      (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m) cp hm,
    one_mul] at h
  exact h.symm

name: Stickelberger.multiplicity_under_gaussSum
statement:
theorem multiplicity_under_gaussSum {m β : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hmdvd : m ∣ p ^ f - 1)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {m} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    {y : 𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)}
    (hy : algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (𝓞 L) y =
      gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * β))
        (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) ^ m)
    (v : Ideal (𝓞 L)) [v.IsPrime] (hvbot : v ≠ ⊥) [v.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})] :
    (p - 1) * multiplicity (v.under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))) (Ideal.span {y})
      = m * multiplicity v (gaussSumIdeal (P := P) (p := p) hf ((p ^ f - 1) / m * β))
proof:
:= by
  set α := (p ^ f - 1) / m * β
  haveI : Algebra.IsIntegral (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (𝓞 L) := inferInstance
  haveI : NoZeroSMulDivisors (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (𝓞 L) :=
    ⟨fun {a b} h => by
      rw [Algebra.smul_def] at h
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with ha | hb
      · exact Or.inl (RingOfIntegers.algebraMap.injective (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m) L ha)
      · exact Or.inr hb⟩
  have hgsne : gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α)
      (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [gaussSumIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] using
      gaussSumIdeal_ne_bot (P := P) (p := p) hf α
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero] at hy
    exact hgsne ((pow_eq_zero_iff (NeZero.ne m)).mp hy.symm)
  have hspan : Ideal.span {y} ≠ ⊥ := by
    simpa [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] using hy0
  have hvprime : Prime v := prime_of_isPrime hvbot inferInstance
  have hfm : FiniteMultiplicity v (gaussSumIdeal (P := P) (p := p) hf α) :=
    FiniteMultiplicity.of_prime_left hvprime (gaussSumIdeal_ne_bot (P := P) (p := p) hf α)
  have hH := Ideal.multiplicity_map_eq_ramificationIdx_mul hspan v hvbot
  rw [gaussSumIdeal_pow_eq_map (m := m) (β := β) hf hy,
    ramificationIdx_under_v_eq hf hmdvd v] at hH
  rw [hfm.multiplicity_pow hvprime] at hH
  exact hH.symm

name: Stickelberger.multiplicity_descended_off_p
statement:
theorem multiplicity_descended_off_p {m β : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hf : 1 ≤ f)
    (hα0 : 0 < (p ^ f - 1) / m * β) (hα : (p ^ f - 1) / m * β < p ^ f - 1)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {m} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    {y : 𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)}
    (hy : algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (𝓞 L) y =
      gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * β))
        (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) ^ m)
    (q : Ideal (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))) [q.IsPrime] (hqbot : q ≠ ⊥)
    (hq : ¬ q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})) :
    multiplicity q (Ideal.span {y}) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hgsne : gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * β))
      (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [gaussSumIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] using
      gaussSumIdeal_ne_bot (P := P) (p := p) hf ((p ^ f - 1) / m * β)
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl; rw [map_zero] at hy; exact hgsne ((pow_eq_zero_iff (NeZero.ne m)).mp hy.symm)
  have hspan : Ideal.span {y} ≠ ⊥ := by simpa [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] using hy0
  
  obtain ⟨Q, _, hQp, hQunder⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral (S := 𝓞 L) q ⊥ (by simp)
  haveI : Q.IsPrime := hQp
  have hQu : Q.under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) = q := hQunder
  haveI : Q.LiesOver q := (Ideal.liesOver_iff Q q).mpr hQu.symm
  have hQbot : Q ≠ ⊥ := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hqbot (hQu.symm.trans (Ideal.comap_bot_of_injective _
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (𝓞 L))))
  have hQ_not_p : ¬ Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) := by
    intro h
    haveI := h
    have hu : (Q.under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))).LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) :=
      Ideal.under_liesOver_of_liesOver (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))
        (𝔓 := Q) (p := Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})
    rw [hQu] at hu
    exact hq hu
  haveI : NoZeroSMulDivisors (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (𝓞 L) :=
    ⟨fun {a b} h => by
      rw [Algebra.smul_def] at h
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with ha | hb
      · exact Or.inl (RingOfIntegers.algebraMap.injective (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m) L ha)
      · exact Or.inr hb⟩
  have hQprime : Prime Q := Ideal.prime_of_isPrime hQbot inferInstance
  have hgi_ne : gaussSumIdeal (P := P) (p := p) hf ((p ^ f - 1) / m * β) ≠ ⊥ :=
    gaussSumIdeal_ne_bot (P := P) (p := p) hf ((p ^ f - 1) / m * β)
  have hmQ0 : multiplicity Q (gaussSumIdeal (P := P) (p := p) hf ((p ^ f - 1) / m * β)) = 0 := by
    have hemult := emultiplicity_gaussSum_off_p (P := P) (p := p) hf
      (teichTowerInv_pow_ne_one (P := P) (p := p) hf hα0 hα) hQprime hQ_not_p
    exact multiplicity_eq_zero.mpr (emultiplicity_eq_zero.mp hemult)
  have hfm : FiniteMultiplicity Q (gaussSumIdeal (P := P) (p := p) hf ((p ^ f - 1) / m * β)) :=
    FiniteMultiplicity.of_prime_left hQprime hgi_ne
  have hrel := Ideal.multiplicity_map_eq_ramificationIdx_mul
    (A := 𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (B := 𝓞 L) hspan Q hQbot
  rw [gaussSumIdeal_pow_eq_map (m := m) (β := β) hf hy, hQu, hfm.multiplicity_pow hQprime,
    hmQ0, Nat.mul_zero] at hrel
  have he : Ideal.ramificationIdx q Q ≠ 0 :=
    IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx_ne_zero_of_liesOver Q hqbot
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (multiplicity q (Ideal.span {y})) with h0 | hpos
  · exact h0
  · exact absurd hrel.symm (mul_ne_zero he (by omega))

name: Stickelberger.multiplicity_under_eq_digitSumF
statement:
theorem multiplicity_under_eq_digitSumF {m β : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hq : 3 ≤ p ^ f)
    (hmdvd : m ∣ p ^ f - 1) (hβ : β < m)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {m} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    {y : 𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)}
    (hy : algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (𝓞 L) y =
      gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * β))
        (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) ^ m)
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) :
    (p - 1) * multiplicity ((σ • P).under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))) (Ideal.span {y})
      = m * digitSumF p f
          (((p ^ f - 1) / m * β
              * (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val) % (p ^ f - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hspanZ : (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]; exact_mod_cast hp.out.ne_zero
  have hP0 : P ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hspanZ P
  have hℓ : 0 < p ^ f - 1 := by omega
  have hdpos : 0 < (p ^ f - 1) / m := Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hℓ hmdvd) (by omega)
  have hα : (p ^ f - 1) / m * β < p ^ f - 1 := by
    calc (p ^ f - 1) / m * β < (p ^ f - 1) / m * m := (Nat.mul_lt_mul_left hdpos).mpr hβ
      _ = p ^ f - 1 := Nat.div_mul_cancel hmdvd
  have hsbot : σ • P ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hspanZ (σ • P)
  rw [multiplicity_under_gaussSum (P := P) hf hmdvd (m := m) (β := β) hy (σ • P) hsbot]
  congr 1
  rw [gaussSumIdeal]
  exact multiplicity_smul_gaussSum_eq_digitSumF hf hq hP0 σ hα

name: Stickelberger.multiplicity_under_eq_digitSumF_index
statement:
theorem multiplicity_under_eq_digitSumF_index {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hr : 2 ≤ m) (hf : 1 ≤ f)
    (hq : 3 ≤ p ^ f) (hmdvd : m ∣ p ^ f - 1)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {m} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    {y : 𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)}
    (hy : algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (𝓞 L) y =
      gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * 1))
        (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) ^ m)
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) :
    (p - 1) * multiplicity ((σ • P).under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))) (Ideal.span {y})
      = m * digitSumF p f
          ((p ^ f - 1) / m * ((galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val % m))
proof:
:= by
  rw [multiplicity_under_eq_digitSumF (β := 1) hf hq hmdvd (by omega) hy σ]
  congr 2
  rw [Nat.mul_one]
  exact div_mul_mod_eq (by omega) hmdvd

name: Stickelberger.multiplicity_under_eq_sum_mod
statement:
theorem multiplicity_under_eq_sum_mod {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hr : 2 ≤ m) (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hq : 3 ≤ p ^ f)
    (hmdvd : m ∣ p ^ f - 1)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {m} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    {y : 𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)}
    (hy : algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (𝓞 L) y =
      gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * 1))
        (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) ^ m)
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) :
    multiplicity ((σ • P).under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))) (Ideal.span {y})
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range f,
          (p ^ i * ((galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val % m)) % m
proof:
:= by
  have key := multiplicity_under_eq_digitSumF_index hr hf hq hmdvd hy σ
  rw [m_mul_digitSumF_div_mul hp.out.two_le hf hmdvd (by omega) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))] at key
  exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by have := hp.out.two_le; omega) key

name: Stickelberger.multiplicity_under_eq_index
statement:
theorem multiplicity_under_eq_index {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hr : 2 ≤ m) (hf1 : f = 1) (hq : 3 ≤ p ^ f)
    (hmdvd : m ∣ p ^ f - 1) (hp1 : (p : ZMod m) = 1)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {m} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    {𝔭₀ : Ideal (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))} [𝔭₀.IsMaximal]
    [𝔭₀.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})]
    (hP0 : P.under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) = 𝔭₀)
    {y : 𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)}
    (hy : algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (𝓞 L) y =
      gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf1.ge)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * 1))
        (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf1.ge) ^ m)
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (a : (ZMod m)ˣ)
    (hfib : (σ • P).under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) = conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) :
    multiplicity (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) (Ideal.span {y}) = (a : ZMod m).val
proof:
:= by
  have hℓ : 0 < p ^ f - 1 := by omega
  have hspan : (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]; exact_mod_cast hp.out.ne_zero
  have hP0' : P ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hspan P
  have hpf : p ^ f - 1 = p - 1 := by rw [hf1, pow_one]
  have hα : (p ^ f - 1) / m * 1 < p ^ f - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.mul_one]; exact Nat.div_lt_self hℓ (by omega)
  have hmult := multiplicity_smul_gaussSum_eq_of_f_eq_one (P := P) (p := p) hf1 hq hP0' σ hα
  rw [show (p ^ f - 1) / m * 1 * (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val
        = (p ^ f - 1) / m * (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val from by ring,
    div_mul_mod_eq (by omega) hmdvd,
    galExp_inv_mod_eq_index (P := P) hr hmdvd hp1 hP0 σ a hfib] at hmult
  have hsbot : σ • P ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hspan (σ • P)
  have hB2 := multiplicity_under_gaussSum (P := P) hf1.ge hmdvd (m := m) (β := 1) hy (σ • P) hsbot
  rw [hfib, hmult, ← Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_div_cancel' hmdvd, hpf] at hB2
  exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by omega) hB2

name: Stickelberger.multiplicity_conjugatePrime_descended
statement:
theorem multiplicity_conjugatePrime_descended {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hr : 2 ≤ m) (hf1 : f = 1)
    (hq : 3 ≤ p ^ f) (hmdvd : m ∣ p ^ f - 1) (hp1 : (p : ZMod m) = 1)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {m} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    {𝔭₀ : Ideal (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))} [𝔭₀.IsMaximal]
    [𝔭₀.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})]
    (hP0 : P.under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) = 𝔭₀)
    {y : 𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)}
    (hy : algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (𝓞 L) y =
      gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf1.ge)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * 1))
        (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf1.ge) ^ m)
    (a : (ZMod m)ˣ) :
    multiplicity (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) (Ideal.span {y}) = (a : ZMod m).val

:= by
  haveI : (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a).IsPrime := by
    rw [conjugatePrime]; exact (Ideal.IsPrime.smul_iff _).mpr inferInstance

    rw [conjugatePrime]; infer_instance
  obtain ⟨Q, _, hQp, hQunder⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral (S := 𝓞 L) (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) ⊥ (by simp)
  haveI : Q.IsPrime := hQp
  haveI : Q.LiesOver (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) := (Ideal.liesOver_iff Q _).mpr hQunder.symm
  haveI : Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) :=
    Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})
  haveI : IsGalois ℚ L := IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois {p * (p ^ f - 1)} ℚ L
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℚ L := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {p * (p ^ f - 1)} ℚ L
  haveI : Finite (L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) := Finite.of_fintype _

    IsGaloisGroup.of_isFractionRing (L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) ℤ (𝓞 L) ℚ L
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := Ideal.exists_smul_eq_of_isGaloisGroup (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) P Q (L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L)
  have hfib : (σ • P).under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) = conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a := by
    rw [hσ]; exact hQunder
  exact multiplicity_under_eq_index hr hf1 hq hmdvd hp1 hP0 hy σ a hfib

statement:
theorem multiplicity_under_eq_s_of_coset {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hr : 2 ≤ m) (hf : 1 ≤ f)
    (hq : 3 ≤ p ^ f) (hmdvd : m ∣ p ^ f - 1) (hn : p.Coprime m) (hmf : orderOf (p : ZMod m) = f)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {m} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    {𝔭₀ : Ideal (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))} [𝔭₀.IsMaximal]
    [𝔭₀.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})]
    (hP0 : P.under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) = 𝔭₀)
    {y : 𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)}
    (hy : algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (𝓞 L) y =
      gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * 1))
        (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) ^ m)
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (a : (ZMod m)ˣ)
    (hfib : (σ • P).under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) = conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) :
    multiplicity (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) (Ideal.span {y})
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range f, (a : ZMod m).val * p ^ i % m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp1le : 1 ≤ p := by have := hp.out.two_le; omega
  set b := ZMod.unitsMap (hmdvd.trans (dvd_mul_left (p ^ f - 1) p))
    (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ) with hbdef
  have hcoset : a * b ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn) :=
    (under_smul_P_eq_conjugatePrime_coset hmdvd hn hP0 σ a).mp hfib
  have hord : orderOf (ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn) = f := orderOf_unitOfCoprime_eq hn hmf
  obtain ⟨j, _, hjpow⟩ : ∃ j ∈ Finset.range f, ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn ^ j = (a * b)⁻¹ := by
    have hmem := mem_zpowers_iff_mem_range_orderOf.mp (inv_mem hcoset)
    rw [hord, Finset.mem_image] at hmem
    exact hmem
  have hbinv : ZMod.unitsMap (hmdvd.trans (dvd_mul_left (p ^ f - 1) p))
      (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹) = a * ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hn ^ j := by
    rw [map_inv, map_inv, ← hbdef, hjpow, mul_inv_rev, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm a b⁻¹, mul_assoc,
      mul_inv_cancel, mul_one]
  have hkm : (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val % m
      = (a : ZMod m).val * p ^ j % m := by
    rw [unitsMap_eq_imp_val_mod hr (hmdvd.trans (dvd_mul_left (p ^ f - 1) p)) _ _ hbinv,
      coe_mul_pow_val hn a j]
  rw [← hfib, multiplicity_under_eq_sum_mod hr hf hq hmdvd hy σ, hkm]
  calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range f, p ^ i * ((a : ZMod m).val * p ^ j % m) % m
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range f, p ^ i * (p ^ j * (a : ZMod m).val % m) % m :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [mul_comm (a : ZMod m).val (p ^ j)])
    _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range f, p ^ i * (a : ZMod m).val % m :=
        sum_mod_p_pow_shift hp1le hmdvd j _
    _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range f, (a : ZMod m).val * p ^ i % m :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [mul_comm (p ^ i) (a : ZMod m).val])

name: Stickelberger.orbit_factorization
statement:
theorem orbit_factorization {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hr : 2 ≤ m) (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hq : 3 ≤ p ^ f)
    (hmdvd : m ∣ p ^ f - 1) (hn : p.Coprime m) (hmf : orderOf (p : ZMod m) = f)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {m} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    {𝔭₀ : Ideal (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))} [𝔭₀.IsMaximal]
    [𝔭₀.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})]
    (hP0 : P.under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) = 𝔭₀)
    {y : 𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)}
    (hy : algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (𝓞 L) y =
      gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * 1))
        (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) ^ m) :
    ∏ a : (ZMod m)ˣ, (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) ^ (a : ZMod m).val = Ideal.span {y}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hℓ : 0 < p ^ f - 1 := by omega
  have hspanZ : (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]; exact_mod_cast hp.out.ne_zero
  have hP0bot : 𝔭₀ ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hspanZ 𝔭₀
  have hα0 : 0 < (p ^ f - 1) / m * 1 := by
    rw [Nat.mul_one]; exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hℓ hmdvd) (by omega)
  have hαlt : (p ^ f - 1) / m * 1 < p ^ f - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.mul_one]; exact Nat.div_lt_self hℓ (by omega)
  have hgsne : gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * 1))
      (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [gaussSumIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] using
      gaussSumIdeal_ne_bot (P := P) (p := p) hf ((p ^ f - 1) / m * 1)
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl; rw [map_zero] at hy; exact hgsne ((pow_eq_zero_iff (NeZero.ne m)).mp hy.symm)
  have hspany : Ideal.span {y} ≠ ⊥ := by simpa [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] using hy0
  have hLHSne : (∏ a : (ZMod m)ˣ, (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) ^ (a : ZMod m).val) ≠ ⊥ :=
    Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
      (fun a _ => pow_ne_zero _ (conjugatePrime_prime inferInstance hP0bot a).ne_zero)
  refine ideal_eq_of_forall_prime_multiplicity hLHSne hspany (fun q hqI hqbot => ?_)
  have hqprime : Prime q := Ideal.prime_of_isPrime hqbot hqI
  have hmult : multiplicity q (∏ a : (ZMod m)ˣ, (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) ^ (a : ZMod m).val)
      = ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a : (ZMod m)ˣ => conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a = q),
          (a : ZMod m).val :=
    multiplicity_conjugatePrime_pow_prod_fiber_sum inferInstance hP0bot _ hqprime
  rw [hmult]
  by_cases hqp : q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})
  · haveI := hqp
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := conjugatePrime_kSubR_surjective (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) 𝔭₀ q
    subst hb
    rw [multiplicity_conjugatePrime_descended_gen hr hf hq hmdvd hn hmf hP0 hy b,
      Finset.filter_congr (fun a _ => by
        rw [conjugatePrime_eq_iff hn, ← inv_mem_iff (x := b * a⁻¹), mul_inv_rev, inv_inv]),
      sum_fiber_val_eq_s hn hmf b]
  · rw [multiplicity_descended_off_p (m := m) (β := 1) hf hα0 hαlt hy q hqbot hqp]
    have hempty : ∀ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod m)ˣ), conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a ≠ q := by
      intro a _ hca
      haveI : (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a).LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) := by
        rw [conjugatePrime]; infer_instance
      exact hqp (hca ▸ ‹(conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a).LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})›)
    rw [Finset.filter_false_of_mem hempty, Finset.sum_empty]

statement:
theorem descended_ideal_pow_eq {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hr : 2 ≤ m) (hf1 : f = 1) (hq : 3 ≤ p ^ f)
    (hmdvd : m ∣ p ^ f - 1) (hp1 : (p : ZMod m) = 1) (c : ℕ) (hcop : c.Coprime m)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {m} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    {𝔭₀ : Ideal (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))} [𝔭₀.IsMaximal]
    [𝔭₀.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})]
    (hP0 : P.under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) = 𝔭₀)
    {y : 𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)}
    (hy : algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) (𝓞 L) y =
      gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf1.ge)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * 1))
        (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf1.ge) ^ m) :
    (Ideal.span {y}) ^ c
      = ((galZMod m (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)).symm (ZMod.unitOfCoprime c hcop)
          • Ideal.span {y}) * (stickelbergerProd (m := m) c 𝔭₀) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set cu := ZMod.unitOfCoprime c hcop with hcu
  set σ := (galZMod m (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)).symm cu with hσdef
  have hℓ : 0 < p ^ f - 1 := by omega
  have hspanZ : (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]; exact_mod_cast hp.out.ne_zero
  have hP0bot : 𝔭₀ ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hspanZ 𝔭₀
  have hα0 : 0 < (p ^ f - 1) / m * 1 := by
    rw [Nat.mul_one]; exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hℓ hmdvd) (by omega)
  have hαlt : (p ^ f - 1) / m * 1 < p ^ f - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.mul_one]; exact Nat.div_lt_self hℓ (by omega)
  have hgsne : gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf1.ge)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / m * 1))
      (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf1.ge) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [gaussSumIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] using
      gaussSumIdeal_ne_bot (P := P) (p := p) hf1.ge ((p ^ f - 1) / m * 1)
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl; rw [map_zero] at hy; exact hgsne ((pow_eq_zero_iff (NeZero.ne m)).mp hy.symm)
  have hspany : Ideal.span {y} ≠ ⊥ := by simpa [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] using hy0
  have hinj := conjugatePrime_kSubR_injective_of_eq_one (L := L) (p := p) (f := f)
    (by omega) hmdvd hp1 𝔭₀
  have hstickne : stickelbergerProd (m := m) c 𝔭₀ ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [stickelbergerProd]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
      (fun a _ => pow_ne_zero _ (conjugatePrime_prime inferInstance hP0bot a).ne_zero)
  have hsmulne : σ • Ideal.span {y} ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [smul_span_singleton, Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
    intro h
    exact hy0 (by have h2 := congrArg (fun z => σ⁻¹ • z) h; simpa using h2)
  have hRHSne : (σ • Ideal.span {y}) * (stickelbergerProd (m := m) c 𝔭₀) ^ m ≠ ⊥ :=
    mul_ne_zero hsmulne (pow_ne_zero m hstickne)
  refine ideal_eq_of_forall_prime_multiplicity (pow_ne_zero c hspany) hRHSne
    (fun q hqI hqbot => ?_)
  haveI := hqI
  have hqprime : Prime q := Ideal.prime_of_isPrime hqbot hqI
  rw [(FiniteMultiplicity.of_prime_left hqprime hspany).multiplicity_pow hqprime,
    multiplicity_mul hqprime (FiniteMultiplicity.of_prime_left hqprime hRHSne),
    (FiniteMultiplicity.of_prime_left hqprime hstickne).multiplicity_pow hqprime]
  by_cases hqp : q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})
  · haveI := hqp

  obtain ⟨σL, hσL⟩ := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective
    (F := ℚ) (K₁ := kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m) (E := L) σ
  have hσL' : σL.restrictNormal (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m) = σ := hσL
  have hunits : ZMod.unitsMap (hmdvd.trans (dvd_mul_left _ _))
      (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σL) = ZMod.unitOfCoprime c hcop := by
    rw [← galEquivZMod_restrictNormal_kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) hmdvd σL, hσL', hσ]
    exact (galZMod m (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)).apply_symm_apply _
  have hc : (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σL).val.val ≡ c [MOD m] := by
    have h1 := unitsMap_eq_imp_val_mod hr (hmdvd.trans (dvd_mul_left _ _)) _
      (ZMod.unitOfCoprime c hcop) hunits
    rw [Nat.ModEq, h1, show ((ZMod.unitOfCoprime c hcop : (ZMod m)ˣ) : ZMod m).val = c % m from by
      rw [ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime, ZMod.val_natCast]]
  have hmem : gL ^ c * (σL gL)⁻¹ ∈ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m : IntermediateField ℚ L) :=
    gaussSum_twist_mem_kSubR (P := P) (β := 1) hr hmdvd hf (by omega) σL hc
  have hgsne : gs ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [gaussSumIdeal, hgs, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] using
      gaussSumIdeal_ne_bot (P := P) (p := p) hf ((p ^ f - 1) / m * 1)
  have hgLne : gL ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hgL, Ne, map_eq_zero_iff _ (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (𝓞 L) L)]; exact hgsne
  have hσLg : σL gL ≠ 0 := fun h => hgLne (by simpa using congrArg σL.symm h)
  have hgLm : gL ^ m = algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) L y := by
    rw [hgL, ← map_pow, ← hy, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  have hσLeq : σL (algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) L y)
      = algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) L (σ • y) := by
    rw [← algebraMap_smul_restrictNormal_smul (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) σL y, hσL']
  have hσLgLm0 : σL (gL ^ m) ≠ 0 := by rw [map_pow]; exact pow_ne_zero m hσLg
  have hzm : (gL ^ c * (σL gL)⁻¹) ^ m
      = algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) L γ := by
    have hkey : (gL ^ m) ^ c
        = σL (gL ^ m) * algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) L γ := by
      rw [hgLm, hσLeq, ← map_pow, hγ, map_mul]
    have htw := twist_pow_eq σL gL hσLg m c
    rw [hkey] at htw
    exact (mul_left_cancel₀ hσLgLm0 htw).symm
  set zK : kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m := ⟨gL ^ c * (σL gL)⁻¹, hmem⟩ with hzK
  have hzKcoe : algebraMap (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m) L zK = gL ^ c * (σL gL)⁻¹ := rfl
  have hzKm : zK ^ m = algebraMap (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))
      (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m) γ := by
    apply (algebraMap (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m) L).injective
    rw [map_pow, hzKcoe, hzm, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  have hzKint : IsIntegral ℤ zK := by
    apply IsIntegral.of_pow (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne m))
    rw [hzKm]
    exact RingOfIntegers.isIntegral_coe γ
  set z₀ : 𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m) := ⟨zK, hzKint⟩ with hz₀
  have hz₀m : z₀ ^ m = γ := by
    apply FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))
      (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)
    rw [map_pow]
    exact hzKm
  have hfinal : stickelbergerProd (m := m) c 𝔭₀ = Ideal.span {z₀} := by
    apply Ideal.pow_left_injective_of_isDedekindDomain (NeZero.ne m)
    rw [hstickγ, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, hz₀m]
  rw [hfinal]
  exact ⟨z₀, rfl⟩

name: Stickelberger.stickelbergerProd_prime_isPrincipal_of_descent
statement:
theorem stickelbergerProd_prime_isPrincipal_of_descent {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hr : 2 ≤ m) (hf : 1 ≤ f)
    (hq : 3 ≤ p ^ f) (hmdvd : m ∣ p ^ f - 1) (hn : p.Coprime m) (hmf : orderOf (p : ZMod m) = f)
    (c : ℕ) (hcop : c.Coprime m)
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {m} ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    [IsGalois ℚ (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)]
    {𝔭₀ : Ideal (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m))} [𝔭₀.IsMaximal]
    [𝔭₀.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})]
    (hP0 : P.under (𝓞 (kSubR (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) m)) = 𝔭₀) :
    Submodule.IsPrincipal (stickelbergerProd (m := m) c 𝔭₀)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
    gaussSum_pow_mem_ringOfIntegers_kSubR (P := P) (β := 1) hr hmdvd hf (by omega)
  exact stickelbergerProd_prime_isPrincipal_gen hr hf hq hmdvd hn hmf c hcop hP0 hy

name: Stickelberger.exists_galEquiv_smul_eq
statement:
theorem exists_galEquiv_smul_eq (P Q : Ideal (𝓞 Kₘ))
    [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})]
    [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})] :
    ∃ σ : Kₘ ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kₘ, σ • P = Q
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsGalois ℚ Kₘ := IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois {m} ℚ Kₘ
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℚ Kₘ := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {m} ℚ Kₘ
  haveI : Finite (Kₘ ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kₘ) := Finite.of_fintype _
  haveI : IsGaloisGroup (Kₘ ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kₘ) ℤ (𝓞 Kₘ) :=
    IsGaloisGroup.of_isFractionRing (Kₘ ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kₘ) ℤ (𝓞 Kₘ) ℚ Kₘ
  exact Ideal.exists_smul_eq_of_isGaloisGroup (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) P Q (Kₘ ≃ₐ[ℚ] Kₘ)

name: Stickelberger.multiplicity_map_eq_zero_of_ne
statement:
theorem multiplicity_map_eq_zero_of_ne {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDedekindDomain A]
    [CommRing B] [IsDedekindDomain B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra.IsIntegral A B]
    [NoZeroSMulDivisors A B] {P : Ideal B} [hP : P.IsPrime] (hPbot : P ≠ ⊥) {q : Ideal A}
    (hq : Prime q) (hqp : q ≠ P.under A) :
    multiplicity P (Ideal.map (algebraMap A B) q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpunder_ne : P.under A ≠ ⊥ := mt Ideal.eq_bot_of_comap_eq_bot hPbot
  have hpunder : Prime (P.under A) := prime_of_isPrime hpunder_ne inferInstance
  rw [multiplicity_eq_zero]
  intro h
  rw [Ideal.dvd_iff_le, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap] at h
  have hle : q ≤ P.under A := by simpa [Ideal.under_def] using h
  exact hqp (((isPrime_of_prime hq).isMaximal hq.ne_zero).eq_of_le
    (isPrime_of_prime hpunder).ne_top hle)

name: Stickelberger.multiplicity_map_eq_ramificationIdx_mul_of_prime
statement:
theorem multiplicity_map_eq_ramificationIdx_mul_of_prime {A B : Type*} [CommRing A]
    [IsDedekindDomain A] [CommRing B] [IsDedekindDomain B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra.IsIntegral A B]
    [NoZeroSMulDivisors A B] {q : Ideal A} (hq : Prime q) (P : Ideal B) [hP : P.IsPrime]
    (hPbot : P ≠ ⊥) :
    multiplicity P (Ideal.map (algebraMap A B) q)
      = (P.under A).ramificationIdx P * multiplicity (P.under A) q
proof:
:= by
  have hpunder_ne : P.under A ≠ ⊥ := mt Ideal.eq_bot_of_comap_eq_bot hPbot
  have hpunder : Prime (P.under A) := prime_of_isPrime hpunder_ne inferInstance
  by_cases hqp : q = P.under A
  · subst hqp
    rw [← IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx_eq_multiplicity (map_ne_bot_of_ne_bot hpunder_ne) hP,
      multiplicity_self, mul_one]
  · have hmap := multiplicity_map_eq_zero_of_ne (P := P) (hPbot := hPbot) hq hqp
    have hdown : multiplicity (P.under A) q = 0 := multiplicity_eq_zero.mpr fun h =>
      hqp (((isPrime_of_prime hq).isMaximal hq.ne_zero).eq_of_le (isPrime_of_prime hpunder).ne_top
        (Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mp h))
    rw [hmap, hdown, mul_zero]

name: Ideal.multiplicity_map_eq_ramificationIdx_mul
statement:
theorem _root_.Ideal.multiplicity_map_eq_ramificationIdx_mul {A B : Type*} [CommRing A]
    [IsDedekindDomain A] [CommRing B] [IsDedekindDomain B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra.IsIntegral A B]
    [NoZeroSMulDivisors A B] {I : Ideal A} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (P : Ideal B) [hP : P.IsPrime]
    (hPbot : P ≠ ⊥) :
    multiplicity P (Ideal.map (algebraMap A B) I)
      = (P.under A).ramificationIdx P * multiplicity (P.under A) I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpunder_ne : P.under A ≠ ⊥ := mt Ideal.eq_bot_of_comap_eq_bot hPbot
  have hPprime : Prime P := prime_of_isPrime hPbot hP
  have hpunder : Prime (P.under A) := prime_of_isPrime hpunder_ne inferInstance
  induction I using UniqueFactorizationMonoid.induction_on_prime with
  | h₁ => exact (hI bot_eq_zero).elim
  | h₂ I hIunit =>
    obtain rfl : I = ⊤ := by simpa using hIunit
    rw [Ideal.map_top, ← Ideal.one_eq_top, multiplicity_of_one_right hPprime.not_unit,
      ← Ideal.one_eq_top (R := A), multiplicity_of_one_right hpunder.not_unit, mul_zero]
  | h₃ J q hJ hq IH =>
    have hJne : J ≠ ⊥ := hJ
    have hprod : q * J ≠ ⊥ := fun h => by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with hq0 | hJ0
      · exact absurd hq0 hq.ne_zero
      · exact hJne hJ0
    have hfm : FiniteMultiplicity P
        (Ideal.map (algebraMap A B) q * Ideal.map (algebraMap A B) J) := by
      rw [← Ideal.map_mul]
      exact FiniteMultiplicity.of_prime_left hPprime (map_ne_bot_of_ne_bot hprod)
    have hfm' : FiniteMultiplicity (P.under A) (q * J) :=
      FiniteMultiplicity.of_prime_left hpunder (by simpa using hprod)
    rw [Ideal.map_mul, multiplicity_mul hPprime hfm, multiplicity_mul hpunder hfm', IH hJne,
      multiplicity_map_eq_ramificationIdx_mul_of_prime hq P hPbot, mul_add]

name: Stickelberger.ideal_eq_of_forall_prime_multiplicity
statement:
theorem ideal_eq_of_forall_prime_multiplicity {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R]
    {I J : Ideal R} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (hJ : J ≠ ⊥)
    (h : ∀ q : Ideal R, q.IsPrime → q ≠ ⊥ → multiplicity q I = multiplicity q J) : I = J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← associated_iff_eq,
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid.associated_iff_normalizedFactors_eq_normalizedFactors hI hJ]
  refine Multiset.ext.mpr fun q => ?_
  by_cases hirr : Irreducible q
  · have hbridge : ∀ K : Ideal R, K ≠ ⊥ →
        (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors K).count q = multiplicity q K :=
      fun K hK => by
        rw [UniqueFactorizationMonoid.multiplicity_eq_count_normalizedFactors hirr hK, normalize_eq]
    rw [hbridge I hI, hbridge J hJ]
    exact h q (Ideal.isPrime_of_prime hirr.prime) (fun hq0 => hirr.ne_zero (by rw [hq0]; rfl))
  · rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr
        (fun hmem => hirr (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_of_normalized_factor q hmem)),
      Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr
        (fun hmem => hirr (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_of_normalized_factor q hmem))]
