name: Stickelberger.conjugatePrime_prime
statement:
theorem conjugatePrime_prime {𝔭₀ : Ideal (𝓞 Kₘ)} (hP : 𝔭₀.IsPrime) (hP0 : 𝔭₀ ≠ ⊥)
    (a : (ZMod m)ˣ) : Prime (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a)
proof:
:= by
  have hpr : (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a).IsPrime := by
    rw [conjugatePrime]; exact (Ideal.IsPrime.smul_iff _).mpr hP
  have hbot : conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [conjugatePrime]; intro h
    apply hP0
    have h2 := congrArg (fun I => ((galZMod m Kₘ).symm a⁻¹)⁻¹ • I) h
    simpa only [inv_smul_smul, Ideal.smul_bot] using h2
  exact Ideal.prime_of_isPrime hbot hpr

name: Stickelberger.multiplicity_conjugatePrime_stickelbergerProd
statement:
theorem multiplicity_conjugatePrime_stickelbergerProd (c : ℕ) {𝔭₀ : Ideal (𝓞 Kₘ)}
    (hP : 𝔭₀.IsPrime) (hP0 : 𝔭₀ ≠ ⊥) (hinj : Function.Injective (conjugatePrime (m := m) 𝔭₀))
    (b : (ZMod m)ˣ) :
    multiplicity (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ b) (stickelbergerProd (m := m) c 𝔭₀)
      = c * (b : ZMod m).val / m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcp : ∀ a : (ZMod m)ˣ, Prime (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) := fun a =>
    conjugatePrime_prime hP hP0 a
  have hprod : stickelbergerProd (m := m) c 𝔭₀
      = ∏ a : (ZMod m)ˣ, (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) ^ (c * (a : ZMod m).val / m) := rfl
  have hemult : emultiplicity (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ b) (stickelbergerProd (m := m) c 𝔭₀)
      = ((c * (b : ZMod m).val / m : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [hprod, Finset.emultiplicity_prod (hcp b), Finset.sum_eq_single b]
    · exact emultiplicity_pow_self_of_prime (hcp b) _
    · intro a _ hab
      rw [emultiplicity_pow (hcp b),
        emultiplicity_eq_zero_of_irreducible_ne (hcp b).irreducible (hcp a).irreducible
          (fun h => hab (hinj h).symm), mul_zero]
    · intro hb; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ b) hb
  exact multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq_some hemult

name: Stickelberger.multiplicity_stickelbergerProd_eq_fiber_sum
statement:
theorem multiplicity_stickelbergerProd_eq_fiber_sum (c : ℕ) {𝔭₀ : Ideal (𝓞 Kₘ)}
    (hP : 𝔭₀.IsPrime) (hP0 : 𝔭₀ ≠ ⊥) {q : Ideal (𝓞 Kₘ)} (hqp : Prime q) :
    multiplicity q (stickelbergerProd (m := m) c 𝔭₀)
      = ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a : (ZMod m)ˣ => conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a = q),
          c * (a : ZMod m).val / m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcp : ∀ a : (ZMod m)ˣ, Prime (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) := fun a =>
    conjugatePrime_prime hP hP0 a
  have hterm : ∀ a : (ZMod m)ˣ,
      emultiplicity q ((conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) ^ (c * (a : ZMod m).val / m))
        = if conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a = q then ((c * (a : ZMod m).val / m : ℕ) : ℕ∞) else 0 := by
    intro a
    by_cases h : conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a = q
    · rw [if_pos h, h, emultiplicity_pow_self_of_prime hqp]
    · rw [if_neg h, emultiplicity_pow hqp,
        emultiplicity_eq_zero_of_irreducible_ne hqp.irreducible (hcp a).irreducible (Ne.symm h),
        mul_zero]
  have hemult : emultiplicity q (stickelbergerProd (m := m) c 𝔭₀)
      = ((∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a : (ZMod m)ˣ => conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a = q),
          c * (a : ZMod m).val / m : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [show stickelbergerProd (m := m) c 𝔭₀
          = ∏ a : (ZMod m)ˣ, (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) ^ (c * (a : ZMod m).val / m) from rfl,
      Finset.emultiplicity_prod hqp, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hterm a),
      ← Finset.sum_filter]
    exact (Nat.cast_sum _ _).symm
  exact multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq_some hemult

name: Stickelberger.multiplicity_conjugatePrime_pow_prod_fiber_sum
statement:
theorem multiplicity_conjugatePrime_pow_prod_fiber_sum {𝔭₀ : Ideal (𝓞 Kₘ)}
    (hP : 𝔭₀.IsPrime) (hP0 : 𝔭₀ ≠ ⊥) (e : (ZMod m)ˣ → ℕ) {q : Ideal (𝓞 Kₘ)} (hqp : Prime q) :
    multiplicity q (∏ a : (ZMod m)ˣ, (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) ^ (e a))
      = ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a : (ZMod m)ˣ => conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a = q), e a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcp : ∀ a : (ZMod m)ˣ, Prime (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) := fun a =>
    conjugatePrime_prime hP hP0 a
  have hterm : ∀ a : (ZMod m)ˣ, emultiplicity q ((conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) ^ (e a))
      = if conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a = q then ((e a : ℕ) : ℕ∞) else 0 := by
    intro a
    by_cases h : conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a = q
    · rw [if_pos h, h, emultiplicity_pow_self_of_prime hqp]
    · rw [if_neg h, emultiplicity_pow hqp,
        emultiplicity_eq_zero_of_irreducible_ne hqp.irreducible (hcp a).irreducible (Ne.symm h),
        mul_zero]
  have hemult : emultiplicity q (∏ a : (ZMod m)ˣ, (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) ^ (e a))
      = ((∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter
          (fun a : (ZMod m)ˣ => conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a = q), e a : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [Finset.emultiplicity_prod hqp, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hterm a),
      ← Finset.sum_filter]
    exact (Nat.cast_sum _ _).symm
  exact multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq_some hemult

name: Stickelberger.multiplicity_stickelbergerProd_eq_zero
statement:
theorem multiplicity_stickelbergerProd_eq_zero (c : ℕ) {𝔭₀ : Ideal (𝓞 Kₘ)}
    (hP : 𝔭₀.IsPrime) (hP0 : 𝔭₀ ≠ ⊥) {q : Ideal (𝓞 Kₘ)} (hqp : Prime q)
    (hq : ∀ a : (ZMod m)ˣ, q ≠ conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) :
    multiplicity q (stickelbergerProd (m := m) c 𝔭₀) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcp : ∀ a : (ZMod m)ˣ, Prime (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) := fun a =>
    conjugatePrime_prime hP hP0 a
  have hprod : stickelbergerProd (m := m) c 𝔭₀
      = ∏ a : (ZMod m)ˣ, (conjugatePrime 𝔭₀ a) ^ (c * (a : ZMod m).val / m) := rfl
  have hemult : emultiplicity q (stickelbergerProd (m := m) c 𝔭₀) = 0 := by
    rw [hprod, Finset.emultiplicity_prod hqp]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun a _ => ?_)
    rw [emultiplicity_pow hqp,
      emultiplicity_eq_zero_of_irreducible_ne hqp.irreducible (hcp a).irreducible (hq a), mul_zero]
  exact multiplicity_eq_zero.mpr (emultiplicity_eq_zero.mp hemult)

name: Stickelberger.s_le
statement:
theorem s_le (hs0 : s 0 = 0) (hs1 : s 1 = 1) (hadd : ∀ a b, s (a + b) ≤ s a + s b) :
    ∀ n, s n ≤ n
proof:
| 0 => by rw [hs0]
  | n + 1 => by
    have h := hadd n 1
    rw [hs1] at h
    have := s_le hs0 hs1 hadd n
    omega

name: Stickelberger.s_pow_mul
statement: theorem s_pow_mul (hfrob : ∀ a, s (p * a) = s a) (i d : ℕ) : s (p ^ i * d) = s d
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc, hfrob, ih]

name: Stickelberger.s_sum_le
statement:
theorem s_sum_le (hs0 : s 0 = 0) (hadd : ∀ a b, s (a + b) ≤ s a + s b) {ι : Type*}
    (g : ι → ℕ) (t : Finset ι) : s (∑ i ∈ t, g i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ t, s (g i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Finset.induction_on t ?_ (fun a t ha ih => ?_)
  · simp [hs0]
  · rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha]
    exact (hadd _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_left ih _)

name: Stickelberger.s_le_digitSumF
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← sum_digit_mul_pow_eq (by omega : 1 ≤ p) hα]
  refine (s_sum_le hs0 hadd (fun i => α / p ^ i % p * p ^ i) (range f)).trans ?_
  rw [digitSumF]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [mul_comm, s_pow_mul hfrob]
  exact s_le hs0 hs1 hadd _

name: Stickelberger.s_eq_digitSumF_of_sum_eq
statement:
theorem s_eq_digitSumF_of_sum_eq (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hs0 : s 0 = 0) (hs1 : s 1 = 1)
    (hadd : ∀ a b, s (a + b) ≤ s a + s b) (hfrob : ∀ a, s (p * a) = s a) {f : ℕ}
    (hsum : ∑ α ∈ range (p ^ f - 1), s α = ∑ α ∈ range (p ^ f - 1), digitSumF p f α)
    {α : ℕ} (hα : α < p ^ f - 1) : s α = digitSumF p f α
proof:
:= by
  have hple : ∀ β ∈ range (p ^ f - 1), s β ≤ digitSumF p f β := by
    intro β hβ
    have hβf : β < p ^ f := by
      have := Finset.mem_range.mp hβ
      have h1 : 1 ≤ p ^ f := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
      omega
    exact s_le_digitSumF hp hs0 hs1 hadd hfrob hβf
  exact (Finset.sum_eq_sum_iff_of_le hple).mp hsum α (Finset.mem_range.mpr hα)

name: Stickelberger.two_mul_sum_s
statement:
theorem two_mul_sum_s {f : ℕ} (hs0 : s 0 = 0)
    (hpair : ∀ a, 0 < a → a < p ^ f - 1 → s a + s (p ^ f - 1 - a) = f * (p - 1)) :
    2 * ∑ α ∈ range (p ^ f - 1), s α = (p ^ f - 2) * (f * (p - 1))
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (p ^ f - 1) with hq0 | hqpos
  · have hz : p ^ f - 2 = 0 := by omega
    rw [hq0, hz]; simp
  
  have hstart : ∑ α ∈ range (p ^ f - 1), s α = ∑ α ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (p ^ f - 1), s α := by
    rw [show range (p ^ f - 1) = insert 0 (Finset.Ico 1 (p ^ f - 1)) from by
          ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_Ico]; omega,
      Finset.sum_insert (by simp), hs0, zero_add]
  have hreindex : ∑ α ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (p ^ f - 1), s (p ^ f - 1 - α)
      = ∑ α ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (p ^ f - 1), s α := by
    rw [Finset.sum_Ico_reflect (f := s) (k := 1) (m := p ^ f - 1) (n := p ^ f - 1) (by omega),
      show p ^ f - 1 + 1 - (p ^ f - 1) = 1 from by omega,
      show p ^ f - 1 + 1 - 1 = p ^ f - 1 from by omega]
  have hpairsum : ∑ α ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (p ^ f - 1), (s α + s (p ^ f - 1 - α))
      = ∑ α ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (p ^ f - 1), f * (p - 1) :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α hα => by
      rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hα; exact hpair α (by omega) (by omega))
  have e : 2 * ∑ α ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (p ^ f - 1), s α
      = ∑ α ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (p ^ f - 1), (s α + s (p ^ f - 1 - α)) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hreindex, two_mul]
  rw [hstart, e, hpairsum, Finset.sum_const, Nat.card_Ico, smul_eq_mul]
  congr 1

name: Stickelberger.s_eq_digitSumF
statement:
theorem s_eq_digitSumF (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hs0 : s 0 = 0) (hs1 : s 1 = 1)
    (hadd : ∀ a b, s (a + b) ≤ s a + s b) (hfrob : ∀ a, s (p * a) = s a) {f : ℕ}
    (hpair : ∀ a, 0 < a → a < p ^ f - 1 → s a + s (p ^ f - 1 - a) = f * (p - 1))
    {α : ℕ} (hα : α < p ^ f - 1) : s α = digitSumF p f α
proof:
:= by
  refine s_eq_digitSumF_of_sum_eq hp hs0 hs1 hadd hfrob ?_ hα
  have hs := two_mul_sum_s hs0 hpair
  have hd := two_mul_sum_digitSumF_lt hp f
  rw [show (p ^ f - 2) * (f * (p - 1)) = f * (p - 1) * (p ^ f - 2) from by ring] at hs
  omega

name: Stickelberger.natCast_p_mem
statement: theorem natCast_p_mem : (p : 𝓞 L) ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  have h := (Ideal.mem_of_liesOver (p := Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) (P := P) (p : ℤ)).mp
    (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  simpa using h

name: Stickelberger.charP_residue
statement: theorem charP_residue : CharP (𝓞 L ⧸ P) p
proof:
:= by
  have hpF0 : (p : 𝓞 L ⧸ P) = 0 := by
    rw [← map_natCast (Ideal.Quotient.mk P) p]
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr natCast_p_mem
  refine ringChar.of_eq ?_
  rcases (Nat.dvd_prime hp.out).mp (ringChar.dvd hpF0) with h1 | h
  · exact absurd ((ringChar.ringChar_eq_one (R := 𝓞 L ⧸ P)).mp h1) (not_subsingleton _)
  · exact h

name: Stickelberger.pf_two
statement: theorem pf_two (hf : 1 ≤ f) : 2 ≤ p ^ f
proof:
:=
  calc 2 ≤ p := hp.out.two_le
    _ = p ^ 1 := (pow_one p).symm
    _ ≤ p ^ f := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by have := hp.out.two_le; omega) hf

name: Stickelberger.N_pos
statement: theorem N_pos (hf : 1 ≤ f) : 0 < p * (p ^ f - 1)
proof:
:=
  Nat.mul_pos (by have := hp.out.two_le; omega) (by have := pf_two (p := p) (f := f) hf; omega)

name: Stickelberger.isPrimitiveRoot_zetaP
statement:
theorem isPrimitiveRoot_zetaP (hf : 1 ≤ f) :
    IsPrimitiveRoot (zetaInteger (K := L) (p * (p ^ f - 1)) ^ (p ^ f - 1)) p
proof:
:=
  (zetaInteger_isPrimitiveRoot (p * (p ^ f - 1))).pow (N_pos hf) (by rw [mul_comm])

name: Stickelberger.mk_teichTower
statement:
theorem mk_teichTower (hf : 1 ≤ f) (a : 𝓞 L ⧸ P) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk P (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf a) = a
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (p ^ f - 1) := ⟨by have := pf_two (p := p) (f := f) hf; omega⟩
  exact mk_teichmuller _ _ a

name: Stickelberger.psiTower_apply
statement:
theorem psiTower_apply (hf : 1 ≤ f) (a : 𝓞 L ⧸ P) :
    haveI := charP_residue (P := P) (p := p)
    psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf a =
      (zetaInteger (K := L) (p * (p ^ f - 1)) ^ (p ^ f - 1)) ^
        (letI : Algebra (ZMod p) (𝓞 L ⧸ P) := ZMod.algebra _ p
         (Algebra.trace (ZMod p) (𝓞 L ⧸ P) a).val)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := charP_residue (P := P) (p := p)
  exact traceAddChar_apply _ _ _

name: Stickelberger.psiTower_isPrimitive
statement: theorem psiTower_isPrimitive (hf : 1 ≤ f) : (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf).IsPrimitive
proof:
:= by
  haveI := charP_residue (P := P) (p := p)
  letI : Algebra (ZMod p) (𝓞 L ⧸ P) := ZMod.algebra _ p
  haveI : Fact (1 < p) := ⟨hp.out.one_lt⟩
  refine AddChar.IsPrimitive.of_ne_one ?_
  rw [AddChar.ne_one_iff]
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Algebra.trace_surjective (ZMod p) (𝓞 L ⧸ P) (1 : ZMod p)
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  rw [psiTower_apply (P := P) (p := p) hf b]
  intro hcon
  rw [(isPrimitiveRoot_zetaP (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) hf).pow_eq_one_iff_dvd, hb,
    ZMod.val_one] at hcon
  have := Nat.le_of_dvd one_pos hcon
  have := hp.out.two_le; omega

name: Stickelberger.emultiplicity_card_residue
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_card_residue (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥) :
    emultiplicity P (Ideal.span {(Fintype.card (𝓞 L ⧸ P) : 𝓞 L)})
      = (f : ℕ∞) * ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have hPp : Prime P := Ideal.prime_of_isPrime hP0 (Ideal.IsMaximal.isPrime ‹P.IsMaximal›)
  have hnat : Nat.card (𝓞 L ⧸ P) = p ^ f := by
    rw [← absNorm_eq_pow_of_ramified (p := p) (f := f) hf P, Ideal.absNorm_apply,
      Submodule.cardQuot_apply]
  have hcardF : (Fintype.card (𝓞 L ⧸ P) : 𝓞 L) = (p : 𝓞 L) ^ f := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hnat]; push_cast; ring
  rw [hcardF, ← Ideal.span_singleton_pow, emultiplicity_pow hPp,
    emultiplicity_span_p_eq_ramificationIdx P hP0,
    ramificationIdx_eq_sub_one (not_dvd_pow_sub_one hf) P]

name: Stickelberger.emultiplicity_gaussSum_teichTower_eq_one
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_gaussSum_teichTower_eq_one (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hq : 3 ≤ p ^ f)
    (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥) :
    emultiplicity P
      (Ideal.span {gaussSum (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)})
      = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI := charP_residue (P := P) (p := p)
  letI : Algebra (ZMod p) (𝓞 L ⧸ P) := ZMod.algebra _ p
  set F := 𝓞 L ⧸ P with hF
  set π : 𝓞 L := zetaInteger (K := L) (p * (p ^ f - 1)) ^ (p ^ f - 1) - 1 with hπdef
  set e : F → ℕ := fun a => (Algebra.trace (ZMod p) F a).val with hedef
  refine emultiplicity_gaussSum_eq_one (π := π) (e := e) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · 
    intro a
    rw [psiTower_apply hf a]
    congr 1
    rw [hπdef]; ring
  · 
    intro hcon
    rw [inv_eq_one] at hcon
    have hcardu : 2 ≤ Fintype.card Fˣ := by
      have habs : absNorm P = p ^ f := absNorm_eq_pow_of_ramified (p := p) (f := f) hf P
      have hcardF : Fintype.card F = p ^ f := by
        rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← habs, Ideal.absNorm_apply, Submodule.cardQuot_apply]
      rw [Fintype.card_units, hcardF]; omega
    haveI : Nontrivial Fˣ := Fintype.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp (by omega)
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_ne (1 : Fˣ)
    have h1 := mk_teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf (u : F)
    rw [hcon, MulChar.one_apply u.isUnit, map_one] at h1
    exact hu (Units.ext h1.symm)
  · 
    rw [hπdef]
    exact emultiplicity_zeta_sub_one (m := p ^ f - 1) (not_dvd_pow_sub_one hf) hP0
      (isPrimitiveRoot_zetaP hf)
  · 
    have hTeich : ∀ a : F, Ideal.Quotient.mk P ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ a) = a⁻¹ := by
      intro a
      rw [MulChar.inv_apply', mk_teichTower]
    have he : ∀ a : F, e a = (Algebra.trace (ZMod p) F a).val := fun a => rfl
    have hmem := sum_mulChar_trace_add_one_mem_ker (L := L) (F := F) p
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk P) hTeich he
    rwa [Ideal.mk_ker] at hmem

name: Stickelberger.card_residue
statement: theorem card_residue (hf : 1 ≤ f) : Fintype.card (𝓞 L ⧸ P) = p ^ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    show Nat.card (𝓞 L ⧸ P) = absNorm P from by
      rw [Ideal.absNorm_apply, Submodule.cardQuot_apply]]
  exact absNorm_eq_pow_of_ramified (p := p) (f := f) hf P

name: Stickelberger.teichTower_pow_card
statement: theorem teichTower_pow_card (hf : 1 ≤ f) : teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf ^ (p ^ f - 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := mulChar_pow_card_sub_one (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)
  rwa [card_residue (p := p) hf] at h

name: Stickelberger.teichTowerInv_pow_card
statement:
theorem teichTowerInv_pow_card (hf : 1 ≤ f) :
    (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ (p ^ f - 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [inv_pow, teichTower_pow_card hf, inv_one]

name: Stickelberger.teichTower_pow_eq_one_imp
statement:
theorem teichTower_pow_eq_one_imp (hf : 1 ≤ f) {a : ℕ}
    (h : teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf ^ a = 1) : (p ^ f - 1) ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hu : ∀ u : (𝓞 L ⧸ P)ˣ, u ^ a = 1 := by
    intro u
    have h1 : (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf ^ a) (↑u) = 1 := by
      rw [h]; exact MulChar.one_apply_coe u
    rw [MulChar.pow_apply_coe] at h1
    have h2 : (↑u : 𝓞 L ⧸ P) ^ a = 1 := by
      have := congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk P) h1
      rwa [map_pow, mk_teichTower, map_one] at this
    exact Units.val_eq_one.mp (by rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val]; exact h2)
  have hcF : Fintype.card (𝓞 L ⧸ P) = p ^ f := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
      show Nat.card (𝓞 L ⧸ P) = absNorm P from by
        rw [Ideal.absNorm_apply, Submodule.cardQuot_apply]]
    exact absNorm_eq_pow_of_ramified (p := p) (f := f) hf P
  have hcard : Nat.card (𝓞 L ⧸ P)ˣ = p ^ f - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_units, hcF]
  have he := Monoid.exponent_dvd_of_forall_pow_eq_one hu
  rwa [IsCyclic.exponent_eq_card, hcard] at he

name: Stickelberger.teichTowerInv_pow_ne_one
statement:
theorem teichTowerInv_pow_ne_one (hf : 1 ≤ f) {a : ℕ} (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha : a < p ^ f - 1) :
    (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ a ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hcon
  rw [inv_pow, inv_eq_one] at hcon
  have := Nat.le_of_dvd ha0 (teichTower_pow_eq_one_imp hf hcon)
  omega

name: Stickelberger.gaussValuationNat_teichTower_one
statement:
theorem gaussValuationNat_teichTower_one (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hq : 3 ≤ p ^ f) (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥) :
    gaussValuationNat P (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) 1
      = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussValuationNat, gaussValuation, pow_one]
  rw [emultiplicity_gaussSum_teichTower_eq_one hf hq hP0]
  rfl

name: Stickelberger.gaussValuationNat_pairing
statement:
theorem gaussValuationNat_pairing (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥) {a : ℕ} (ha0 : 0 < a)
    (ha : a < p ^ f - 1) :
    gaussValuationNat P (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) a
      + gaussValuationNat P (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)
          (p ^ f - 1 - a) = f * (p - 1)
proof:
:= by
  set ω := (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ with hωdef
  set ψ := psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf with hψdef
  have hP : Prime P := Ideal.prime_of_isPrime hP0 (Ideal.IsMaximal.isPrime ‹P.IsMaximal›)
  have hχ : ω ^ a ≠ 1 := by rw [hωdef]; exact teichTowerInv_pow_ne_one hf ha0 ha
  have hψ' : ψ.IsPrimitive := by rw [hψdef]; exact psiTower_isPrimitive (P := P) (p := p) hf
  have hωcard : ω ^ (p ^ f - 1) = 1 := by rw [hωdef]; exact teichTowerInv_pow_card hf
  have hcard : (Fintype.card (𝓞 L ⧸ P) : 𝓞 L) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [card_residue (p := p) hf]
    exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (pow_pos hp.out.pos f).ne'
  have hord : (ω ^ a) ^ (p ^ f - 1) = 1 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm a (p ^ f - 1), pow_mul, hωcard, one_pow]
  have hfo : IsOfFinOrder (ω ^ a) :=
    isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.mpr ⟨p ^ f - 1, by omega, hord⟩
  have hchar : (ω ^ a) ^ (orderOf (ω ^ a) - 1) = ω ^ (p ^ f - 1 - a) := by
    have hA : (ω ^ a) ^ (orderOf (ω ^ a) - 1) = (ω ^ a)⁻¹ := by
      refine (inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_left ?_).symm
      rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hfo.orderOf_pos, pow_orderOf_eq_one]
    have hB : (ω ^ a)⁻¹ = ω ^ (p ^ f - 1 - a) := by
      refine inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_left ?_
      rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel (le_of_lt ha)]
      exact hωcard
    rw [hA, hB]
  have hai := gaussValuationNat_add_inv hP hχ hψ' hcard
  have hr1 : gaussValuationNat P (ω ^ a) ψ 1 = gaussValuationNat P ω ψ a := by
    simp only [gaussValuationNat, gaussValuation, pow_one]
  have hr2 : gaussValuationNat P (ω ^ a) ψ (orderOf (ω ^ a) - 1)
      = gaussValuationNat P ω ψ (p ^ f - 1 - a) := by
    simp only [gaussValuationNat, gaussValuation, hchar]
  rw [hr1, hr2] at hai
  rw [hai, emultiplicity_card_residue (p := p) hf hP0, ENat.toNat_mul, ENat.toNat_coe,
    ENat.toNat_coe]

name: Stickelberger.psiTower_pow_frobenius
statement:
theorem psiTower_pow_frobenius (hf : 1 ≤ f) (x : 𝓞 L ⧸ P) :
    psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf (x ^ p) = psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf x
proof:
:= by
  haveI := charP_residue (P := P) (p := p)
  letI : Algebra (ZMod p) (𝓞 L ⧸ P) := ZMod.algebra _ p
  have hσx : (FiniteField.frobeniusAlgEquivOfAlgebraic (ZMod p) (𝓞 L ⧸ P)) x = x ^ p := by
    rw [FiniteField.coe_frobeniusAlgEquivOfAlgebraic, ZMod.card]
  have htr : Algebra.trace (ZMod p) (𝓞 L ⧸ P) (x ^ p) = Algebra.trace (ZMod p) (𝓞 L ⧸ P) x := by
    rw [← hσx]; exact Algebra.trace_eq_of_algEquiv _ x
  rw [psiTower_apply hf, psiTower_apply hf, htr]

name: Stickelberger.gaussValuationNat_frobenius
statement:
theorem gaussValuationNat_frobenius (hf : 1 ≤ f) (a : ℕ) :
    gaussValuationNat P (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) (p * a)
      = gaussValuationNat P (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)
          a
proof:
:= by
  haveI := charP_residue (P := P) (p := p)
  have hpow : ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹) ^ (p * a)
      = (((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹) ^ a) ^ p := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm a p]
  have hgf : gaussSum ((((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹) ^ a) ^ p)
        (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)
      = gaussSum (((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹) ^ a) (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) :=
    gaussSum_pow_frobenius p (psiTower_pow_frobenius hf)
  simp only [gaussValuationNat, gaussValuation, hpow, hgf]

name: Stickelberger.gaussValuationNat_eq_digitSumF
statement:
theorem gaussValuationNat_eq_digitSumF (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hq : 3 ≤ p ^ f) (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥)
    {α : ℕ} (hα : α < p ^ f - 1) :
    gaussValuationNat P (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) α
      = digitSumF p f α
proof:
:= by
  have hP : Prime P := Ideal.prime_of_isPrime hP0 (Ideal.IsMaximal.isPrime ‹P.IsMaximal›)
  have hψ' : (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf).IsPrimitive := psiTower_isPrimitive hf
  have hψ1 : psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf ≠ 1 :=
    fun h => (hψ' one_ne_zero) (by rw [AddChar.mulShift_one]; exact h)
  have hcard : (Fintype.card (𝓞 L ⧸ P) : 𝓞 L) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [card_residue (p := p) hf]; exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (pow_pos hp.out.pos f).ne'
  have hfin : ∀ c, gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ c)
      (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) ≠ 0 := fun c => gaussSum_pow_ne_zero hψ' hcard c
  exact s_eq_digitSumF hp.out.two_le (gaussValuationNat_zero hP hψ1)
    (gaussValuationNat_teichTower_one hf hq hP0) (gaussValuationNat_add_le hP hψ1 hfin)
    (gaussValuationNat_frobenius hf) (fun a ha0 ha => gaussValuationNat_pairing hf hP0 ha0 ha) hα

name: Stickelberger.emultiplicity_gaussSum_eq_digitSumF
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_gaussSum_eq_digitSumF (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hq : 3 ≤ p ^ f) (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥)
    {α : ℕ} (hα : α < p ^ f - 1) :
    emultiplicity P (Ideal.span {gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α)
      (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)}) = (digitSumF p f α : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have hP : Prime P := Ideal.prime_of_isPrime hP0 (Ideal.IsMaximal.isPrime ‹P.IsMaximal›)
  have hcard : (Fintype.card (𝓞 L ⧸ P) : 𝓞 L) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [card_residue (p := p) hf]; exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (pow_pos hp.out.pos f).ne'
  have hg0 : gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α)
      (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) ≠ 0 :=
    gaussSum_pow_ne_zero (psiTower_isPrimitive (P := P) (p := p) hf) hcard α
  have hne := gaussValuation_ne_top hP hg0
  have hcoe : gaussValuation P (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) α
      = ((gaussValuationNat P (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹
          (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) α : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := (ENat.coe_toNat hne).symm
  rw [gaussValuationNat_eq_digitSumF hf hq hP0 hα] at hcoe
  exact hcoe

name: Stickelberger.emultiplicity_gaussSum_off_p
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_gaussSum_off_p (hf : 1 ≤ f) {ω : MulChar (𝓞 L ⧸ P) (𝓞 L)} (hω : ω ≠ 1)
    {Q : Ideal (𝓞 L)} (hQp : Prime Q) (hnotover : ¬ Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})) :
    emultiplicity Q (Ideal.span {gaussSum ω (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)}) = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Q.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_of_prime hQp
  apply emultiplicity_gaussSum_eq_zero hQp hω (psiTower_isPrimitive (P := P) (p := p) hf)
  rw [card_residue (p := p) hf, show ((p ^ f : ℕ) : 𝓞 L) = (p : 𝓞 L) ^ f from by push_cast; ring]
  exact emultiplicity_span_pow_eq_zero hQp (fun h => hnotover (liesOver_of_natCast_mem h)) f

name: Stickelberger.smul_eq_pow_of_pow_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (𝓞 L) L
  rw [map_pow, show algebraMap (𝓞 L) L (σ • x) = σ (algebraMap (𝓞 L) L x) from
    algebraMap_galRestrict_apply ℤ σ x]
  exact galEquivZMod_apply_of_pow_eq (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ (by rw [← map_pow, hx, map_one])

name: Stickelberger.smul_eq_pow_c_of_pow_eq_one
statement:
theorem smul_eq_pow_c_of_pow_eq_one (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) {u : 𝓞 L} {m c : ℕ} (hmdvd : m ∣ p ^ f - 1)
    (hu : u ^ m = 1) (hc : (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ).val.val ≡ c [MOD m]) :
    σ • u = u ^ c
proof:
:= by
  have huN : u ^ (p * (p ^ f - 1)) = 1 := by
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hmdvd
    rw [show p * (p ^ f - 1) = m * (p * d) by rw [hd]; ring, pow_mul, hu, one_pow]
  rw [smul_eq_pow_of_pow_eq σ huN, pow_eq_pow_of_modEq hc hu]

name: Stickelberger.smul_eq_pow_c_field
statement:
theorem smul_eq_pow_c_field (σc : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) {u : L} {m c : ℕ} (hm0 : 0 < m)
    (hmdvd : m ∣ p ^ f - 1) (hu : u ^ m = 1)
    (hc : (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σc).val.val ≡ c [MOD m]) :
    σc u = u ^ c
proof:
:= by
  have hint : IsIntegral ℤ u := IsIntegral.of_pow hm0 (by rw [hu]; exact isIntegral_one)
  obtain ⟨u', hu'⟩ : ∃ u' : 𝓞 L, algebraMap (𝓞 L) L u' = u :=
    ⟨⟨u, (mem_integralClosure_iff (R := ℤ) (A := L)).2 hint⟩, rfl⟩
  have hu'm : u' ^ m = 1 := by
    apply FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (𝓞 L) L
    rw [map_pow, hu', hu, map_one]
  have hbridge : algebraMap (𝓞 L) L (σc • u') = σc (algebraMap (𝓞 L) L u') :=
    algebraMap_galRestrict_apply ℤ σc u'
  calc σc u = σc (algebraMap (𝓞 L) L u') := by rw [hu']
    _ = algebraMap (𝓞 L) L (σc • u') := hbridge.symm
    _ = algebraMap (𝓞 L) L (u' ^ c) := by rw [smul_eq_pow_c_of_pow_eq_one σc hmdvd hu'm hc]
    _ = (algebraMap (𝓞 L) L u') ^ c := map_pow _ _ _
    _ = u ^ c := by rw [hu']

name: Stickelberger.zetaP_pow_N_eq_one
statement:
theorem zetaP_pow_N_eq_one (hf : 1 ≤ f) :
    (zetaInteger (K := L) (p * (p ^ f - 1)) ^ (p ^ f - 1)) ^ (p * (p ^ f - 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_mul, show (zetaInteger (K := L) (p * (p ^ f - 1)) ^ (p ^ f - 1)) ^ p = 1 from
    (isPrimitiveRoot_zetaP (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) hf).pow_eq_one, one_pow]

name: Stickelberger.smul_zetaP_eq_pow
statement:
theorem smul_zetaP_eq_pow (hf : 1 ≤ f) (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) :
    σ • (zetaInteger (K := L) (p * (p ^ f - 1)) ^ (p ^ f - 1)) =
      (zetaInteger (K := L) (p * (p ^ f - 1)) ^ (p ^ f - 1)) ^
        (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ).val.val
proof:
:=
  smul_eq_pow_of_pow_eq σ (zetaP_pow_N_eq_one (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) hf)

name: Stickelberger.smul_psiTower_apply
statement:
theorem smul_psiTower_apply (hf : 1 ≤ f) (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (a : 𝓞 L ⧸ P) :
    σ • (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf a) =
      psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf
        (((galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ).val.val : 𝓞 L ⧸ P) * a)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := charP_residue (P := P) (p := p)
  letI : Algebra (ZMod p) (𝓞 L ⧸ P) := ZMod.algebra _ p
  rw [psiTower_apply hf a, psiTower_apply hf _]
  set ζ := zetaInteger (K := L) (p * (p ^ f - 1)) ^ (p ^ f - 1) with hζ
  set k := (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ).val.val with hk
  set T := Algebra.trace (ZMod p) (𝓞 L ⧸ P) with hT
  have hsz : σ • ζ = ζ ^ k := smul_zetaP_eq_pow hf σ
  rw [show σ • ζ ^ (T a).val = (σ • ζ) ^ (T a).val from
        map_pow (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom (L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (𝓞 L) σ) ζ _,
      hsz, ← pow_mul]
  have htr : T (((k : 𝓞 L ⧸ P)) * a) = (k : ZMod p) * T a := by
    rw [hT, show ((k : 𝓞 L ⧸ P)) = algebraMap (ZMod p) (𝓞 L ⧸ P) (k : ZMod p) from
          (map_natCast (algebraMap (ZMod p) (𝓞 L ⧸ P)) k).symm,
        ← Algebra.smul_def, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hfo : IsOfFinOrder ζ := isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.mpr
    ⟨p, hp.out.pos, (isPrimitiveRoot_zetaP (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) hf).pow_eq_one⟩
  rw [htr, hfo.pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq,
      ← (isPrimitiveRoot_zetaP (L := L) (p := p) (f := f) hf).eq_orderOf,
      ← ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff]
  push_cast
  simp [ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.cast_id]

name: Stickelberger.smul_gaussSum
statement:
theorem smul_gaussSum (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (χ : MulChar (𝓞 L ⧸ P) (𝓞 L))
    (ψ : AddChar (𝓞 L ⧸ P) (𝓞 L)) :
    σ • gaussSum χ ψ = ∑ a, (σ • χ a) * (σ • ψ a)
proof:
:=
  map_gaussSum (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom (L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (𝓞 L) σ) χ ψ

name: Stickelberger.mulChar_apply_unit_pow_card_sub_one
statement:
theorem mulChar_apply_unit_pow_card_sub_one (hf : 1 ≤ f) (χ : MulChar (𝓞 L ⧸ P) (𝓞 L))
    (u : (𝓞 L ⧸ P)ˣ) : (χ (u : 𝓞 L ⧸ P)) ^ (p ^ f - 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (congrArg DFunLike.coe (mulChar_pow_card_sub_one χ)) (u : 𝓞 L ⧸ P)
  rwa [MulChar.pow_apply_coe, MulChar.one_apply_coe, card_residue (p := p) hf] at h

name: Stickelberger.mulChar_apply_unit_pow_N
statement:
theorem mulChar_apply_unit_pow_N (hf : 1 ≤ f) (χ : MulChar (𝓞 L ⧸ P) (𝓞 L))
    (u : (𝓞 L ⧸ P)ˣ) : (χ (u : 𝓞 L ⧸ P)) ^ (p * (p ^ f - 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, pow_mul, mulChar_apply_unit_pow_card_sub_one (p := p) hf χ u, one_pow]

name: Stickelberger.smul_mulChar_apply_unit
statement:
theorem smul_mulChar_apply_unit (hf : 1 ≤ f) (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (χ : MulChar (𝓞 L ⧸ P) (𝓞 L))
    (u : (𝓞 L ⧸ P)ˣ) :
    σ • (χ (u : 𝓞 L ⧸ P)) =
      (χ ^ (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ).val.val) (u : 𝓞 L ⧸ P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_eq_pow_of_pow_eq σ (mulChar_apply_unit_pow_N (p := p) hf χ u), MulChar.pow_apply_coe]

name: Stickelberger.isUnit_galExponent_residue
statement:
theorem isUnit_galExponent_residue (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) :
    IsUnit (((galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ).val.val : 𝓞 L ⧸ P))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := charP_residue (P := P) (p := p)
  rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
  intro hzero
  rw [CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (𝓞 L ⧸ P) p] at hzero
  have hcop := ZMod.val_coe_unit_coprime (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ)
  have hkp : Nat.Coprime ((galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ : ZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1))).val) p :=
    hcop.coprime_dvd_right (dvd_mul_right p (p ^ f - 1))
  exact (hp.out.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mp hkp.symm) hzero

name: Stickelberger.inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_sum
statement:
theorem inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_sum (hf : 1 ≤ f) (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (α : ℕ) :
    haveI := charP_residue (P := P) (p := p)
    letI : Algebra (ZMod p) (𝓞 L ⧸ P) := ZMod.algebra _ p
    σ⁻¹ • gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α) (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) =
      ∑ a : 𝓞 L ⧸ P,
        (((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α) ^
            (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val) a *
          psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf
            (((galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val : 𝓞 L ⧸ P) * a)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := charP_residue (P := P) (p := p)
  letI : Algebra (ZMod p) (𝓞 L ⧸ P) := ZMod.algebra _ p
  rw [smul_gaussSum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha
  · simp [MulChar.map_zero]
  · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha
    have hψ := smul_psiTower_apply (P := P) (p := p) hf σ⁻¹ (↑u : 𝓞 L ⧸ P)
    rw [smul_mulChar_apply_unit (p := p) hf σ⁻¹ _ u, hψ]

name: Stickelberger.isUnit_mulChar_apply_unit
statement:
theorem isUnit_mulChar_apply_unit (η : MulChar (𝓞 L ⧸ P) (𝓞 L)) (v : (𝓞 L ⧸ P)ˣ) :
    IsUnit (η (v : 𝓞 L ⧸ P))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨η (v : 𝓞 L ⧸ P), η ((v⁻¹ : (𝓞 L ⧸ P)ˣ) : 𝓞 L ⧸ P), ?_, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  · rw [← map_mul, ← Units.val_mul, mul_inv_cancel, Units.val_one, map_one]
  · rw [← map_mul, ← Units.val_mul, inv_mul_cancel, Units.val_one, map_one]

name: Stickelberger.smul_pow
statement:
theorem smul_pow (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (x : 𝓞 L) (n : ℕ) :
    σ • x ^ n = (σ • x) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  set ρ := MulSemiringAction.toRingHom (L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (𝓞 L) σ with hρ
  show ρ (x ^ n) = ρ x ^ n
  exact map_pow ρ x n

name: Stickelberger.teichTowerInv_pow_mul_rpow_eq_one
statement:
theorem teichTowerInv_pow_mul_rpow_eq_one (hf : 1 ≤ f) {r β : ℕ} (hrdvd : r ∣ p ^ f - 1) :
    ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / r * β)) ^ r
      = (1 : MulChar (𝓞 L ⧸ P) (𝓞 L))
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : (p ^ f - 1) / r * β * r = (p ^ f - 1) * β := by
    rw [mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm β r, ← mul_assoc, Nat.div_mul_cancel hrdvd]
  rw [← pow_mul, hexp, pow_mul, teichTowerInv_pow_card hf, one_pow]

name: Stickelberger.isUnit_mulChar_apply_unit_pow_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : (η (v : 𝓞 L ⧸ P)) ^ r = 1 := by
    have := congrFun (congrArg DFunLike.coe hη) (v : 𝓞 L ⧸ P)
    rwa [MulChar.pow_apply_coe, MulChar.one_apply_coe] at this
  exact (Units.ext_iff).2 (by rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, IsUnit.unit_spec, hpow, Units.val_one])

name: Stickelberger.inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul_coe
statement:
theorem inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul_coe (hf : 1 ≤ f) (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (α : ℕ) :
    σ⁻¹ • gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α) (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) =
      ↑(isUnit_mulChar_apply_unit
          (((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α) ^
              (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val)⁻¹
          (isUnit_galExponent_residue (P := P) (p := p) (f := f) σ⁻¹).unit).unit *
        gaussSum (((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α) ^
            (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val) (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := charP_residue (P := P) (p := p)
  letI : Algebra (ZMod p) (𝓞 L ⧸ P) := ZMod.algebra _ p
  set k := (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val with hk
  set χ := ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α) ^ k with hχ
  set ψ := psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf with hψ
  set kU := (isUnit_galExponent_residue (P := P) (p := p) (f := f) σ⁻¹).unit with hkU
  rw [inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_sum hf σ α]
  have hrec : (∑ a : 𝓞 L ⧸ P, χ a * ψ ((k : 𝓞 L ⧸ P) * a)) =
      gaussSum χ (AddChar.mulShift ψ (kU : 𝓞 L ⧸ P)) := by
    rw [gaussSum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
    rw [AddChar.mulShift_apply, hkU, IsUnit.unit_spec]
  rw [hrec, gaussSum_mulShift_eq χ ψ kU]
  congr 1

name: Stickelberger.inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul
statement:
theorem inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul (hf : 1 ≤ f) (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (α : ℕ) :
    ∃ u : (𝓞 L)ˣ,
      σ⁻¹ • gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α) (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) =
        ↑u * gaussSum (((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α) ^
            (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val) (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul_coe (P := P) (p := p) hf σ α⟩

name: Stickelberger.teichTowerInv_pow_eq_mod
statement:
theorem teichTowerInv_pow_eq_mod (hf : 1 ≤ f) (a : ℕ) :
    (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ a =
      (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ (a % (p ^ f - 1))
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.div_add_mod a (p ^ f - 1)]
  rw [pow_add, pow_mul, teichTowerInv_pow_card hf, one_pow, one_mul]

name: Stickelberger.inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul_self
statement:
theorem inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul_self (hf : 1 ≤ f) (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (α : ℕ)
    (hαk : α * (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val ≡ α [MOD p ^ f - 1]) :
    ∃ u : (𝓞 L)ˣ,
      σ⁻¹ • gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α) (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) =
        ↑u * gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α)
          (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul (P := P) (p := p) hf σ α
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  have hchar : ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α) ^
      (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val = (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α := by
    rw [← pow_mul, teichTowerInv_pow_eq_mod hf, show
      (α * (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val) % (p ^ f - 1) = α % (p ^ f - 1) from hαk,
      ← teichTowerInv_pow_eq_mod hf]
  rw [hu, hchar]

name: Stickelberger.inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul_self_unit_pow_eq_one
statement:
theorem inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul_self_unit_pow_eq_one {r β : ℕ} (hf : 1 ≤ f)
    (hrdvd : r ∣ p ^ f - 1) (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L)
    (hαk : (p ^ f - 1) / r * β * (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val
      ≡ (p ^ f - 1) / r * β [MOD p ^ f - 1]) :
    ∀ u : (𝓞 L)ˣ,
      σ⁻¹ • gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / r * β))
          (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) =
        ↑u * gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ ((p ^ f - 1) / r * β))
          (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf) →
      u ^ r = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  set α := (p ^ f - 1) / r * β
  set ω := (teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹
  set ψ := psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf
  set g := gaussSum (ω ^ α) ψ
  set k := (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val with hk
  set χ := (ω ^ α) ^ k with hχ
  set kU := (isUnit_galExponent_residue (P := P) (p := p) (f := f) σ⁻¹).unit with hkU
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀⟩ := inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul (P := P) (p := p) hf σ α
  have hu₀' : σ⁻¹ • g = ↑u₀ * gaussSum χ ψ := by simpa [α, ω, ψ, g, hχ, hk] using hu₀
  have hχeq : χ = ω ^ α := by
    rw [hχ, hk, ← pow_mul, teichTowerInv_pow_eq_mod hf,
      show (α * k) % (p ^ f - 1) = α % (p ^ f - 1) from hαk, ← teichTowerInv_pow_eq_mod hf]
  have hgne : (g : 𝓞 L) ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [g, ω, ψ]
    have hcard : (Fintype.card (𝓞 L ⧸ P) : 𝓞 L) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [card_residue (p := p) hf]; exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (pow_pos hp.out.pos f).ne'
    exact gaussSum_pow_ne_zero (psiTower_isPrimitive (P := P) (p := p) hf) hcard α
  have hgsum : gaussSum χ ψ = g := by dsimp [g]; rw [← hχeq]
  have hmul : (↑u : 𝓞 L) * g = (↑u₀ : 𝓞 L) * g := by rw [← hu, hu₀', hgsum]
  have hueq : u = u₀ := Units.ext (mul_right_cancel₀ hgne hmul)
  set uCanon := (isUnit_mulChar_apply_unit χ⁻¹ kU).unit with huCanondef
  have huCanon : σ⁻¹ • g = ↑uCanon * gaussSum χ ψ := by
    simpa [α, ω, ψ, g, hχ, hk, hkU, huCanondef] using
      inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul_coe (P := P) (p := p) hf σ α
  have hmul' : (↑u₀ : 𝓞 L) * g = (↑uCanon : 𝓞 L) * g := by
    calc (↑u₀ : 𝓞 L) * g = (↑u₀ : 𝓞 L) * gaussSum χ ψ := by rw [← hgsum]
      _ = σ⁻¹ • g := hu₀'.symm
      _ = (↑uCanon : 𝓞 L) * gaussSum χ ψ := huCanon
      _ = (↑uCanon : 𝓞 L) * g := by rw [hgsum]
  have hu₀eq : u₀ = uCanon := Units.ext (mul_right_cancel₀ hgne hmul')
  have hχr : (ω ^ α) ^ r = 1 := teichTowerInv_pow_mul_rpow_eq_one hf hrdvd
  have hχr' : χ ^ r = 1 := by rw [hχeq, hχr]
  have hηr : χ⁻¹ ^ r = 1 := by rw [inv_pow, hχr', inv_one]
  rw [hueq, hu₀eq, isUnit_mulChar_apply_unit_pow_eq_one kU hηr]

name: Stickelberger.emultiplicity_smul_gaussSum_eq_digitSumF
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_smul_gaussSum_eq_digitSumF (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hq : 3 ≤ p ^ f) (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥)
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) {α : ℕ} (hα : α < p ^ f - 1) :
    emultiplicity (σ • P)
        (Ideal.span {gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α)
          (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)})
      = (digitSumF p f
          ((α * (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val) % (p ^ f - 1)) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have hσ : emultiplicity (σ • P)
      (Ideal.span {gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α)
        (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)})
      = emultiplicity P (Ideal.span {σ⁻¹ •
        gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α) (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)}) := by
    have h := emultiplicity_smul σ P (σ⁻¹ •
      gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α) (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf))
    rwa [smul_inv_smul] at h
  rw [hσ]
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := inv_smul_gaussSum_eq_unit_mul (P := P) (p := p) hf σ α
  rw [hu, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit u.isUnit, ← pow_mul,
    teichTowerInv_pow_eq_mod hf,
    emultiplicity_gaussSum_eq_digitSumF hf hq hP0
      (Nat.mod_lt _ (show 0 < p ^ f - 1 by omega))]

name: Stickelberger.multiplicity_smul_gaussSum_eq_digitSumF
statement:
theorem multiplicity_smul_gaussSum_eq_digitSumF (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hq : 3 ≤ p ^ f) (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥)
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) {α : ℕ} (hα : α < p ^ f - 1) :
    multiplicity (σ • P)
        (Ideal.span {gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)⁻¹ ^ α)
          (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf)})
      = digitSumF p f ((α * (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val) % (p ^ f - 1))
proof:
:=
  multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq_some
    (emultiplicity_smul_gaussSum_eq_digitSumF hf hq hP0 σ hα)

name: Stickelberger.gaussSumIdeal_ne_bot
statement:
theorem gaussSumIdeal_ne_bot (hf : 1 ≤ f) (α : ℕ) :
    gaussSumIdeal (P := P) (p := p) hf α ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussSumIdeal, Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
  have hcard : (Fintype.card (𝓞 L ⧸ P) : 𝓞 L) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [card_residue (p := p) hf]; exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (pow_pos hp.out.pos f).ne'
  exact gaussSum_pow_ne_zero (psiTower_isPrimitive (P := P) (p := p) hf) hcard α

name: Stickelberger.multiplicity_smul_gaussSum_mod_of_f_eq_one
statement:
theorem multiplicity_smul_gaussSum_mod_of_f_eq_one (hf1 : f = 1) (hq : 3 ≤ p ^ f) (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥)
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) {α : ℕ} (hα : α < p ^ f - 1) :
    multiplicity (σ • P) (gaussSumIdeal (P := P) (p := p) hf1.ge α)
      = ((α * (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val) % (p ^ f - 1)) % p
proof:
:= by
  rw [show gaussSumIdeal (P := P) (p := p) hf1.ge α
      = Ideal.span {gaussSum ((teichTower (P := P) (p := p) hf1.ge)⁻¹ ^ α)
          (psiTower (P := P) (p := p) hf1.ge)} from rfl,
    multiplicity_smul_gaussSum_eq_digitSumF hf1.ge hq hP0 σ hα]
  
  
  exact (congrArg (fun n => digitSumF p n
      ((α * (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val) % (p ^ f - 1))) hf1).trans
    (digitSumF_one p _)

name: Stickelberger.multiplicity_smul_gaussSum_eq_of_f_eq_one
statement:
theorem multiplicity_smul_gaussSum_eq_of_f_eq_one (hf1 : f = 1) (hq : 3 ≤ p ^ f) (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥)
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) {α : ℕ} (hα : α < p ^ f - 1) :
    multiplicity (σ • P) (gaussSumIdeal (P := P) (p := p) hf1.ge α)
      = (α * (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val) % (p ^ f - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [multiplicity_smul_gaussSum_mod_of_f_eq_one hf1 hq hP0 σ hα]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  have h1 : (α * (galEquivZMod (p * (p ^ f - 1)) L σ⁻¹).val.val) % (p ^ f - 1) < p ^ f - 1 :=
    Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h2 : p ^ f = p := by rw [hf1, pow_one]
  omega

name: Stickelberger.traceAddChar_apply
statement:
theorem traceAddChar_apply {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP F p] [NeZero p] {ζ : R} (hζ : ζ ^ p = 1) (x : F) :
    letI : Algebra (ZMod p) F := ZMod.algebra F p
    traceAddChar p hζ x = ζ ^ (Algebra.trace (ZMod p) F x).val
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra (ZMod p) F := ZMod.algebra F p
  rw [traceAddChar, AddChar.compAddMonoidHom_apply, AddChar.zmodChar_apply]
  rfl

name: Stickelberger.sum_inv_mul_trace
statement:
theorem sum_inv_mul_trace (F : Type*) [Field F] [Fintype F] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP F p] :
    letI : Algebra (ZMod p) F := ZMod.algebra F p
    ∑ a : F, a⁻¹ * algebraMap (ZMod p) F (Algebra.trace (ZMod p) F a) = -1
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra (ZMod p) F := ZMod.algebra F p
  classical
  have hp2 : 2 ≤ p := (Fact.out : p.Prime).two_le
  set f := Module.finrank (ZMod p) F with hf
  have hNc : Nat.card (ZMod p) = p := by rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ZMod.card]
  have hcardF : Fintype.card F = p ^ f := by
    rw [Module.card_eq_pow_finrank (K := ZMod p) (V := F), ZMod.card]
  have hf0 : 0 < f := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos f with h | h
    · rw [h, pow_zero] at hcardF
      have := Fintype.one_lt_card (α := F); omega
    · exact h
  calc ∑ a : F, a⁻¹ * algebraMap (ZMod p) F (Algebra.trace (ZMod p) F a)
      = ∑ a : F, ∑ i ∈ range f, a⁻¹ * a ^ (p ^ i) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
        rw [FiniteField.algebraMap_trace_eq_sum_pow (ZMod p) F a, Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [hNc])
    _ = ∑ i ∈ range f, ∑ a : F, a⁻¹ * a ^ (p ^ i) := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ a : F, a⁻¹ * a ^ (p ^ 0) := by
        refine Finset.sum_eq_single 0 (fun i hi hne => ?_) (fun h => ?_)
        · 
          have hi' : i < f := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
          have hii : 1 ≤ i := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne
          have hle : 1 ≤ p ^ i := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
          have hpge : 2 ≤ p ^ i := by
            calc 2 ≤ p := hp2
              _ = p ^ 1 := (pow_one p).symm
              _ ≤ p ^ i := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hii
          have hpow : ∀ a : F, a⁻¹ * a ^ (p ^ i) = a ^ (p ^ i - 1) := by
            intro a
            rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha
            · rw [inv_zero, zero_mul, zero_pow (by omega)]
            · rw [pow_sub₀ a ha hle, pow_one]; exact mul_comm _ _
          simp_rw [hpow]
          refine FiniteField.sum_pow_lt_card_sub_one F (p ^ i - 1) ?_
          rw [hcardF]
          have : p ^ i < p ^ f := Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by omega) hi'
          omega
        · exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr hf0) h
    _ = -1 := by
        simp only [pow_zero, pow_one]
        have hpt : ∀ a : F, a⁻¹ * a = 1 - (if a = 0 then (1 : F) else 0) := by
          intro a
          rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha
          · simp
          · rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ ha, if_neg ha]; ring
        simp_rw [hpt]
        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
          Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (0 : F) (fun _ => (1 : F))]
        simp

name: Stickelberger.gaussSum_one_eq_neg_one
statement:
theorem gaussSum_one_eq_neg_one {ψ : AddChar F (𝓞 L)} (hψ : ψ ≠ 1) :
    gaussSum (1 : MulChar F (𝓞 L)) ψ = -1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsum : ∑ a : F, ψ a = 0 := AddChar.sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one hψ
  have key : ∑ a : F, (1 : MulChar F (𝓞 L)) a * ψ a
      = (∑ a : F, ψ a) - ∑ a : F, (if a = 0 then (1 : 𝓞 L) else 0) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
    rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha
    · rw [if_pos rfl, MulChar.map_nonunit _ (by simp), zero_mul, AddChar.map_zero_eq_one]
      ring
    · rw [if_neg ha, MulChar.one_apply (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha), one_mul, sub_zero]
  rw [gaussSum, key, hsum]
  simp

name: Stickelberger.isUnit_span_gaussSum_of_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.isUnit_iff, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top, ha, gaussSum_one_eq_neg_one hψ]
  exact isUnit_one.neg

name: Stickelberger.gaussValuation_zero
statement:
theorem gaussValuation_zero {P : Ideal (𝓞 L)} (hP : Prime P) {ω : MulChar F (𝓞 L)}
    {ψ : AddChar F (𝓞 L)} (hψ : ψ ≠ 1) : gaussValuation P ω ψ 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  emultiplicity_of_isUnit_right hP.not_unit (isUnit_span_gaussSum_of_eq_one hψ (pow_zero ω))

name: Stickelberger.gaussValuation_ne_top
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussValuation, ← finiteMultiplicity_iff_emultiplicity_ne_top]
  refine FiniteMultiplicity.of_not_isUnit hP.not_unit ?_
  rw [Ideal.zero_eq_bot]
  exact fun h => hne (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.mp h)

name: Stickelberger.gaussSum_pow_frobenius
statement:
theorem gaussSum_pow_frobenius (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP F p] [PerfectRing F p]
    {χ : MulChar F (𝓞 L)} {ψ : AddChar F (𝓞 L)} (hψ : ∀ x : F, ψ (x ^ p) = ψ x) :
    gaussSum (χ ^ p) ψ = gaussSum χ ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussSum, gaussSum, ← Equiv.sum_comp (frobeniusEquiv F p).toEquiv (fun a => χ a * ψ a)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
  have hfa : (frobeniusEquiv F p).toEquiv a = a ^ p := by
    simp [frobeniusEquiv, frobenius_def]
  rw [hfa, hψ, map_pow]
  congr 1
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha
  · rw [MulChar.map_zero, MulChar.map_zero, zero_pow (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero]
  · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha
    rw [MulChar.pow_apply_coe]

name: Stickelberger.mulChar_pow_card_sub_one
statement: theorem mulChar_pow_card_sub_one (χ : MulChar F (𝓞 L)) : χ ^ (Fintype.card F - 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rw [MulChar.pow_apply_coe, ← map_pow, FiniteField.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one _ (Units.ne_zero a),
    MulChar.map_one, MulChar.one_apply_coe]

name: Stickelberger.map_gaussSum
statement:
theorem map_gaussSum (τ : 𝓞 L →+* 𝓞 L) (χ : MulChar F (𝓞 L)) (ψ : AddChar F (𝓞 L)) :
    τ (gaussSum χ ψ) = ∑ a, τ (χ a) * τ (ψ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussSum, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => map_mul τ _ _)

name: Stickelberger.gaussSum_pow_ne_zero
statement:
theorem gaussSum_pow_ne_zero {ω : MulChar F (𝓞 L)} {ψ : AddChar F (𝓞 L)} (hψ' : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hcard : (Fintype.card F : 𝓞 L) ≠ 0) (c : ℕ) : gaussSum (ω ^ c) ψ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hψ1 : ψ ≠ 1 := fun h => (hψ' one_ne_zero) (by rw [AddChar.mulShift_one]; exact h)
  rcases eq_or_ne (ω ^ c) 1 with h | h
  · rw [h, gaussSum_one_eq_neg_one hψ1]; exact neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero
  · exact gaussSum_ne_zero_of_nontrivial hcard h hψ'

name: Stickelberger.gaussValuation_add_le
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (ω ^ (a + b)) 1 with h1 | hne
  · rw [gaussValuation, emultiplicity_of_isUnit_right hP.not_unit
      (isUnit_span_gaussSum_of_eq_one hψ h1)]
    exact zero_le
  · rw [gaussValuation, gaussValuation, gaussValuation, ← emultiplicity_mul hP]
    apply emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_of_dvd_right
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton]
    have heq : gaussSum (ω ^ a) ψ * gaussSum (ω ^ b) ψ
        = gaussSum (ω ^ (a + b)) ψ * jacobiSum (ω ^ a) (ω ^ b) := by
      rw [pow_add]; exact (jacobiSum_mul_nontrivial (by rwa [← pow_add]) ψ).symm
    rw [heq, ← Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton]
    exact dvd_mul_right _ _

name: Stickelberger.gaussValuationNat_zero
statement:
theorem gaussValuationNat_zero {P : Ideal (𝓞 L)} (hP : Prime P) {ω : MulChar F (𝓞 L)}
    {ψ : AddChar F (𝓞 L)} (hψ : ψ ≠ 1) : gaussValuationNat P ω ψ 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussValuationNat, gaussValuation_zero hP hψ]; rfl

name: Stickelberger.gaussValuationNat_add_le
statement:
theorem gaussValuationNat_add_le {P : Ideal (𝓞 L)} (hP : Prime P) {ω : MulChar F (𝓞 L)}
    {ψ : AddChar F (𝓞 L)} (hψ : ψ ≠ 1) (hfin : ∀ c, gaussSum (ω ^ c) ψ ≠ 0) (a b : ℕ) :
    gaussValuationNat P ω ψ (a + b)
      ≤ gaussValuationNat P ω ψ a + gaussValuationNat P ω ψ b
proof:
:= by
  have hfa := gaussValuation_ne_top hP (hfin a)
  have hfb := gaussValuation_ne_top hP (hfin b)
  rw [gaussValuationNat, gaussValuationNat, gaussValuationNat, ← ENat.toNat_add hfa hfb]
  exact ENat.toNat_le_toNat (gaussValuation_add_le hP hψ a b)
    (fun h => (WithTop.add_eq_top.mp h).elim hfa hfb)

name: Stickelberger.gaussSum_sub_linear_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hrw : gaussSum ω ψ - (∑ a, ω a + π * ∑ a, ω a * (e a : 𝓞 L))
      = ∑ a, (ω a * ψ a - ω a - π * (ω a * (e a : 𝓞 L))) := by
    rw [gaussSum, Finset.mul_sum, sub_add_eq_sub_sub, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
      ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [hrw]
  refine Ideal.sum_mem _ (fun a _ => ?_)
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  have hb : π ^ 2 ∣ (1 + π) ^ e a - (1 + (e a) • π) := sq_dvd_one_add_pow_sub π (e a)
  have heq : ω a * ψ a - ω a - π * (ω a * (e a : 𝓞 L))
      = ω a * ((1 + π) ^ e a - (1 + (e a) • π)) := by
    rw [hψ a, nsmul_eq_mul]; ring
  rw [heq]
  exact hb.mul_left _

name: Stickelberger.emultiplicity_gaussSum_eq_one
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_gaussSum_eq_one {P : Ideal (𝓞 L)} {ω : MulChar F (𝓞 L)}
    {ψ : AddChar F (𝓞 L)} {π : 𝓞 L} {e : F → ℕ} (hψ : ∀ a, ψ a = (1 + π) ^ e a)
    (hω : ω ≠ 1) (hπ : emultiplicity P (Ideal.span {π}) = 1)
    (hcong : (∑ a, ω a * (e a : 𝓞 L)) + 1 ∈ P) :
    emultiplicity P (Ideal.span {gaussSum ω ψ}) = 1
proof:
:= by
  set S : 𝓞 L := ∑ a, ω a * (e a : 𝓞 L) with hSdef
  
  have hπP : π ∈ P := by
    have h1 : P ^ 1 ∣ Ideal.span {π} := pow_dvd_iff_le_emultiplicity.mpr (by simp [hπ])
    rwa [pow_one, Ideal.dvd_span_singleton] at h1
  
  have hS0 : ∑ a, ω a = 0 := MulChar.sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one hω
  have hmem : gaussSum ω ψ - π * S ∈ Ideal.span {π ^ 2} := by
    have := gaussSum_sub_linear_mem (ω := ω) (ψ := ψ) (π := π) (e := e) hψ
    rwa [hS0, zero_add] at this
  
  have hsq : π ^ 2 ∈ P ^ 2 := by
    rw [pow_two, pow_two]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hπP hπP
  have hsub2 : Ideal.span {π ^ 2} ≤ P ^ 2 :=
    Ideal.span_le.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hsq)
  have hπS1 : π * (S + 1) ∈ P ^ 2 := by rw [pow_two]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hπP hcong
  
  have hgπ : gaussSum ω ψ - (-π) ∈ P ^ 2 := by
    have hcombine : gaussSum ω ψ - (-π) = (gaussSum ω ψ - π * S) + π * (S + 1) := by ring
    rw [hcombine]
    exact (P ^ 2).add_mem (hsub2 hmem) hπS1
  
  have hbval : emultiplicity P (Ideal.span {(-π)}) = 1 := by
    rwa [Ideal.span_singleton_neg]
  exact emultiplicity_eq_one_of_sub_mem hbval hgπ

name: Stickelberger.emultiplicity_gaussSum_add_inv
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_gaussSum_add_inv {P : Ideal (𝓞 L)} (hP : Prime P) {ω : MulChar F (𝓞 L)}
    {ψ : AddChar F (𝓞 L)} (hχ : ω ≠ 1) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    emultiplicity P (Ideal.span {gaussSum ω ψ})
      + emultiplicity P (Ideal.span {gaussSum (ω ^ (orderOf ω - 1)) ψ})
      = emultiplicity P (Ideal.span {(Fintype.card F : 𝓞 L)})
proof:
:= by
  have huχ : IsUnit (ω (-1)) := by
    have h : ω (-1) * ω (-1) = 1 := by
      rw [← map_mul, show ((-1 : F) * (-1)) = 1 from by ring, MulChar.map_one]
    exact ⟨⟨ω (-1), ω (-1), h, h⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [← emultiplicity_mul hP, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton,
    gaussSum_mul_gaussSum_pow_orderOf_sub_one hχ hψ, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit huχ]

name: Stickelberger.emultiplicity_gaussSum_eq_zero
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_gaussSum_eq_zero {Q : Ideal (𝓞 L)} (hQ : Prime Q) {ω : MulChar F (𝓞 L)}
    {ψ : AddChar F (𝓞 L)} (hχ : ω ≠ 1) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hcard : emultiplicity Q (Ideal.span {(Fintype.card F : 𝓞 L)}) = 0) :
    emultiplicity Q (Ideal.span {gaussSum ω ψ}) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hadd := emultiplicity_gaussSum_add_inv hQ hχ hψ
  rw [hcard] at hadd
  exact eq_zero_of_add_right hadd

name: Stickelberger.gaussValuationNat_add_inv
statement:
theorem gaussValuationNat_add_inv {P : Ideal (𝓞 L)} (hP : Prime P) {ω : MulChar F (𝓞 L)}
    {ψ : AddChar F (𝓞 L)} (hχ : ω ≠ 1) (hψ' : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hcard : (Fintype.card F : 𝓞 L) ≠ 0) :
    gaussValuationNat P ω ψ 1 + gaussValuationNat P ω ψ (orderOf ω - 1)
      = (emultiplicity P (Ideal.span {(Fintype.card F : 𝓞 L)})).toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussValuationNat, gaussValuationNat, ← ENat.toNat_add
      (gaussValuation_ne_top hP (gaussSum_pow_ne_zero hψ' hcard 1))
      (gaussValuation_ne_top hP (gaussSum_pow_ne_zero hψ' hcard (orderOf ω - 1)))]
  congr 1
  simp only [gaussValuation, pow_one]
  exact emultiplicity_gaussSum_add_inv hP hχ hψ'

name: Stickelberger.sum_mulChar_trace_add_one_mem_ker
statement:
theorem sum_mulChar_trace_add_one_mem_ker (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP F p]
    {ω : MulChar F (𝓞 L)} {e : F → ℕ} (φ : 𝓞 L →+* F)
    (hTeich : ∀ a : F, φ (ω a) = a⁻¹)
    (he : ∀ a : F, e a = letI : Algebra (ZMod p) F := ZMod.algebra F p
      (Algebra.trace (ZMod p) F a).val) :
    (∑ a, ω a * (e a : 𝓞 L)) + 1 ∈ RingHom.ker φ
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra (ZMod p) F := ZMod.algebra F p
  haveI : NeZero p := ⟨(Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero⟩
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_add, map_one, map_sum]
  have hcast : ∀ i : ZMod p, ((i.val : F)) = algebraMap (ZMod p) F i := by
    intro i; rw [ZMod.natCast_val]; exact (ZMod.castHom_apply i).symm
  have hterm : ∀ a : F, φ (ω a * (e a : 𝓞 L))
      = a⁻¹ * algebraMap (ZMod p) F (Algebra.trace (ZMod p) F a) := by
    intro a
    rw [map_mul, hTeich, map_natCast, he a, hcast]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hterm a), sum_inv_mul_trace F p]
  ring

name: Stickelberger.rootsOfUnityMapQuot_bijective
statement:
theorem rootsOfUnityMapQuot_bijective {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {ζ : 𝓞 K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n)
    {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K)} [𝔭.IsMaximal] (habs : absNorm 𝔭 = n + 1) :
    Function.Bijective (rootsOfUnityMapQuot 𝔭 n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Field (𝓞 K ⧸ 𝔭) := Ideal.Quotient.field 𝔭
  have hne1 : absNorm 𝔭 ≠ 1 := by rw [habs]; have := NeZero.pos n; omega
  have hcop : (absNorm 𝔭).Coprime n := by
    rw [habs, Nat.coprime_self_add_left]; exact Nat.coprime_one_left n
  have : Fintype (𝓞 K ⧸ 𝔭) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hN : Nat.card (𝓞 K ⧸ 𝔭) = n + 1 := by
    rw [← habs, Ideal.absNorm_apply, Submodule.cardQuot_apply]
  refine (Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card _).mpr
    ⟨rootsOfUnityMapQuot_injective n hne1 hcop, ?_⟩
  have hcard : Fintype.card ((𝓞 K ⧸ 𝔭)ˣ) = n := by
    have h1 : Fintype.card ((𝓞 K ⧸ 𝔭)ˣ) = Fintype.card (𝓞 K ⧸ 𝔭) - 1 :=
      Fintype.card_units (𝓞 K ⧸ 𝔭)
    rw [h1, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hN, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  rw [hζ.card_rootsOfUnity, hcard]

name: Stickelberger.map_teichmullerUnitHom
statement:
theorem map_teichmullerUnitHom {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {ζ : 𝓞 K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n)
    {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K)} [𝔭.IsMaximal] (habs : absNorm 𝔭 = n + 1) (a : ((𝓞 K) ⧸ 𝔭)ˣ) :
    Units.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔭).toMonoidHom (teichmullerUnitHom hζ habs a) = a
proof:
:=
  MulEquiv.ofBijective_apply_symm_apply (n := a) (rootsOfUnityMapQuot 𝔭 n)
    (rootsOfUnityMapQuot_bijective hζ habs)

name: Stickelberger.mk_teichmullerUnitHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_teichmullerUnitHom {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {ζ : 𝓞 K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n)
    {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K)} [𝔭.IsMaximal] (habs : absNorm 𝔭 = n + 1) (a : ((𝓞 K) ⧸ 𝔭)ˣ) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔭 (teichmullerUnitHom hζ habs a : 𝓞 K) = (a : (𝓞 K) ⧸ 𝔭)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Units.val (map_teichmullerUnitHom (𝔭 := 𝔭) hζ habs a)
  simpa using h

name: Stickelberger.mk_teichmuller
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_teichmuller {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {ζ : 𝓞 K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n)
    {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K)} [𝔭.IsMaximal] (habs : absNorm 𝔭 = n + 1) (a : (𝓞 K) ⧸ 𝔭) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔭 (teichmuller hζ habs a) = a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Field (𝓞 K ⧸ 𝔭) := Ideal.Quotient.field 𝔭
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha
  · simp [(teichmuller hζ habs).map_zero]
  · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha)
    rw [teichmuller, MulChar.ofUnitHom_coe]
    exact mk_teichmullerUnitHom hζ habs u
